  (body (!= (contains s x) (contains s y))))
(ghost-fn wfv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))))
(ghost-fn light ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (iset int)) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (crosses s u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
(ghost-fn closedset ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (iset int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (not (crosses s u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn best ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (iset int)) (found bool) (bw int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u2 int) (i2 int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2)))))
             (and (or (< u2 u) (and (== u2 u) (< i2 i))) (crosses s u2 (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0))))
        (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn cand ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (iset int)) (found bool) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int) (bi int)) bool
  (body (=> found
    (and (and (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu (len g))) (and (<= 0 bi) (< bi (len (idx g bu)))))
         (and (and (== (get (idx (idx g bu) bi) 0) bv) (== (get (idx (idx g bu) bi) 1) bw)) (crosses s bu bv))))))
(ghost-fn mirror ((t (seq int)) (s (iset int))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len t)))
    (and (or (== (idx t y) 0) (== (idx t y) 1)) (== (== (idx t y) 1) (contains s y)))))))

  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t))) (< k (len cuts)))

         (and (contains (idx cuts k) 0)
              (and (inside (idx cuts k) (take t k)) (spans (idx cuts k) (take t k))))))))

      (or (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) x) (== (get (idx f e) 1) y))
          (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) y) (== (get (idx f e) 1) x)))))))

    (assert (path_follows_edges f p))

(lemma rev_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges f p)
    (== (len q) (len p))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))) (== (idx q i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let j int (- (- (len p) 2) k))
    (assert (== (idx q k) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (edge_in_set f (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (call edge_sym f (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected f x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected f y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f p)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i)))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_at f p q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))
    (assert (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) y) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges f q)))))
(lemma cat_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges f p)
    (path_follows_edges f r)
    (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len r) 0))
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx r 0))
    (== (len s) (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))) (== (idx s i) (idx p i))))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= (len p) i) (< i (len s))) (== (idx s i) (idx r (+ (- i (len p)) 1)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len s) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f (idx s k) (idx s (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx s (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set f (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
        (assert (== (idx s k) (idx r m)))
        (assert (== (idx s (+ k 1)) (idx r (+ m 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set f (idx r m) (idx r (+ m 1))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected f x y) (edges_connected f y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected f x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f p)))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) y) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges f r)))
    (ghost-let s (seq int) (seq-build (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1) (fn (i) (if (< i (len p)) (idx p i) (idx r (+ (- i (len p)) 1))))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_at f p r s k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f s))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) z))
    (assert (and (and (> (len s) 0) (and (== (idx s 0) x) (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges f s)))))
(lemma mono_at (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (sub f1 f2) (path_follows_edges f1 p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f2 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body (assert (edge_in_set f1 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (sub f1 f2) (edges_connected f1 x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected f2 x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f1 p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call mono_at f1 f2 p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f2 p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f2 p)))))
(lemma sub_prefix_at (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (prefix_of f1 f2) (edge_in_set f1 u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f2 u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f1)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f1 e) 0) u) (== (get (idx f1 e) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx f1 e) 0) v) (== (get (idx f1 e) 1) u)))))
    (assert (== (idx f2 e) (idx f1 e)))))
(lemma sub_prefix (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))))

(lemma prefix_push (params (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))

(lemma seg_conn (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (d int) (m int))
  (requires (seg_in f p d) (and (and (<= 0 d) (<= d m)) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected f (idx p d) (idx p m)))
  (decreases (- m d))
  (body
    (if (== m d)
      (call conn_refl f (idx p d))
      (block
        (call seg_conn f p d (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set f (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_edge f (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))
        (call conn_trans f (idx p d) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))))))
(lemma out_at (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (iset int)) (a int) (b int)
                      (p (seq int)) (d int) (i int))
  (requires (except f1 f2 a b) (crosses s a b) (path_follows_edges f1 p) (outside s p d)
            (and (and (<= d i) (<= 0 i)) (< i (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f2 (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set f1 (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
    (assert (not (contains s (idx p i))))
    (assert (not (contains s (idx p (+ i 1)))))
    (assert (or (edge_in_set f2 (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1)))
                (or (and (== (idx p i) a) (== (idx p (+ i 1)) b)) (and (== (idx p i) b) (== (idx p (+ i 1)) a)))))))
(lemma out_seg (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (iset int)) (a int) (b int)
                       (p (seq int)) (d int))
  (requires (except f1 f2 a b) (crosses s a b) (path_follows_edges f1 p) (outside s p d))
  (ensures (seg_in f2 p d))
  (body (forall ((i int)) (call out_at f1 f2 s a b p d i))))
(lemma last_in (params (s (iset int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (contains s (idx p 0)) (not (contains s (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
            (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len p))) (outside s p m))
  (ensures (exists ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< (+ c 1) (len p))) (and (contains s (idx p c)) (outside s p (+ c 1))))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (contains s (idx p (- m 1)))
      (block
        (assert (< m (len p)))
        (assert (outside s p (+ (- m 1) 1)))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (+ (- m 1) 1) (len p)))
                     (and (contains s (idx p (- m 1))) (outside s p (+ (- m 1) 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (> m 1))
        (assert (outside s p (- m 1)))
        (call last_in s p (- m 1))))))
(lemma reroute (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (r (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (except f1 f2 a b) (edges_connected f2 a b) (path_follows_edges f1 r) (> (len r) 0)
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len r))))
  (ensures (edges_connected f2 (idx r 0) (idx r m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call conn_refl f2 (idx r 0))
      (block
        (call reroute f1 f2 a b r (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set f1 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m)))
        (assert (or (edge_in_set f2 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m))
                    (or (and (== (idx r (- m 1)) a) (== (idx r m) b)) (and (== (idx r (- m 1)) b) (== (idx r m) a)))))
        (if (edge_in_set f2 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m))
          (call conn_edge f2 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m))
          (if (== (idx r (- m 1)) a) (block) (call conn_sym f2 a b)))
        (assert (edges_connected f2 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m)))
        (call conn_trans f2 (idx r 0) (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m))))))
(lemma qspan_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                        (a int) (b int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g f1) (except f1 f2 a b) (edges_connected f2 a b)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))))
  (ensures (edges_connected f2 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected f1 u v))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) u) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges f1 r)))
    (call reroute f1 f2 a b r (- (len r) 1))))
(lemma qs_at (params (pt (seq (tuple int int int))) (qt (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int))
                     (k int) (j int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (swapped pt qt e k j) (edge_in_set pt u v))
  (ensures (or (edge_in_set qt u v)
               (or (and (== u (get (idx pt j) 0)) (== v (get (idx pt j) 1)))
                   (and (== u (get (idx pt j) 1)) (== v (get (idx pt j) 0))))))
  (body
    (obtain ((t2 int)) (and (and (<= 0 t2) (< t2 (len pt)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx pt t2) 0) u) (== (get (idx pt t2) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx pt t2) 0) v) (== (get (idx pt t2) 1) u)))))
    (if (== t2 j)
      (block)
      (if (== t2 k)
        (block (assert (== (idx qt j) (idx pt k))) (assert (edge_in_set qt u v)))
        (block (assert (== (idx qt t2) (idx pt t2))) (assert (edge_in_set qt u v)))))))
(lemma qv_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (pt (seq (tuple int int int)))
                     (qt (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int) (j int) (q int))
  (requires (swapped pt qt e k j) (== (len t) (len pt)) (== e (idx t k))
            (are_valid_edges g t) (are_valid_edges g pt) (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len qt))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx qt q) 0) (get (idx qt q) 1) (get (idx qt q) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== q k)
      (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1) (get (idx t k) 2)))
      (if (== q j)
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx pt k) 0) (get (idx pt k) 1) (get (idx pt k) 2)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx pt q) 0) (get (idx pt q) 1) (get (idx pt q) 2)))))))
(lemma valid_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (wfv g) (are_valid_edges g t) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx t k) 0)) (< (get (idx t k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx t k) 1)) (< (get (idx t k) 1) (len g)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1) (get (idx t k) 2)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx t k) 0)) (< (get (idx t k) 0) (len g)))
                                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (get (idx t k) 0))))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t k) 0)) i) 0) (get (idx t k) 1))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t k) 0)) i) 1) (get (idx t k) 2)))))))
(lemma tw_point (params (s1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (== (len s2) (len s1)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s1)))
            (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len s1))) (!= q i)) (== (idx s2 q) (idx s1 q)))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight s2) (+ (- (total_weight s1) (get (idx s1 i) 2)) (get (idx s2 i) 2))))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight s1) (+ (get (idx s1 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s1 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight s2) (+ (get (idx s2 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s2 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop s2 1)) (len (drop s1 1))))
        (assert (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (drop s1 1)))) (== (idx (drop s2 1) q) (idx (drop s1 1) q)))))
        (assert (== (drop s2 1) (drop s1 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop s2 1)) (len (drop s1 1))))
        (assert (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (drop s1 1)))) (!= q (- i 1)))
                                      (== (idx (drop s2 1) q) (idx (drop s1 1) q)))))
        (call tw_point (drop s1 1) (drop s2 1) (- i 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop s1 1) (- i 1)) (idx s1 i)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop s2 1) (- i 1)) (idx s2 i)))
        (assert (== (idx s2 0) (idx s1 0)))))))
(lemma qt_conn
  (params (s (iset int)) (fk (seq (tuple int int int))) (pt (seq (tuple int int int))) (qt (seq (tuple int int int)))
          (e (tuple int int int)) (k int) (j int) (ea int) (eb int) (p (seq int)) (c int))
  (requires
    (spans s fk)
    (and (contains s ea) (not (contains s eb)))
    (sub fk qt)
    (swapped pt qt e k j)
    (== (idx qt k) e)
    (or (and (== ea (get e 0)) (== eb (get e 1))) (and (== ea (get e 1)) (== eb (get e 0))))
    (path_follows_edges pt p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) eb)
    (and (<= 0 c) (< (+ c 1) (len p)))
    (contains s (idx p c))
    (outside s p (+ c 1))
    (except pt qt (get (idx pt j) 0) (get (idx pt j) 1))
    (crosses s (get (idx pt j) 0) (get (idx pt j) 1))
    (or (and (== (get (idx pt j) 0) (idx p c)) (== (get (idx pt j) 1) (idx p (+ c 1))))
        (and (== (get (idx pt j) 0) (idx p (+ c 1))) (== (get (idx pt j) 1) (idx p c)))))
  (ensures (edges_connected qt (get (idx pt j) 0) (get (idx pt j) 1)))
  (body
    (ghost-let a1 int (get (idx pt j) 0))
    (ghost-let b1 int (get (idx pt j) 1))
    (ghost-let pc int (idx p c))
    (ghost-let pd int (idx p (+ c 1)))
    (assert (not (contains s pd)))

    (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len f1))) (== (idx f2 q) (idx f1 q)))))))
(ghost-fn except ((f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (=> (edge_in_set f1 u v)
    (or (edge_in_set f2 u v) (or (and (== u a) (== v b)) (and (== u b) (== v a))))))))
(ghost-fn seg_in ((f (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= d i) (<= 0 i)) (< i (- (len p) 1)))
    (edge_in_set f (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1)))))))
(ghost-fn outside ((s (iset int)) (p (seq int)) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= d i) (<= 0 i)) (< i (len p))) (not (contains s (idx p i)))))))
(ghost-fn swapped ((pt (seq (tuple int int int))) (qt (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int) (j int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len qt) (len pt)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (<= k j)) (< j (len pt))))
    (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len pt)))
      (== (idx qt q) (if (== q k) e (if (== q j) (idx pt k) (idx pt q)))))))))
(ghost-fn agree ((pt (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q k)) (and (< q (len pt)) (< q (len t))))
    (== (idx pt q) (idx t q))))))

(lemma edge_sym (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set f x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) x) (== (get (idx f e) 1) y))
          (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) y) (== (get (idx f e) 1) x)))))))
(lemma conn_refl (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (ensures (edges_connected f x x))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x))
    (assert (and (== (len p) 1) (== (idx p 0) x)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges f p)))))
(lemma conn_edge (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set f x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected f x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x y))
    (assert (and (and (== (len p) 2) (== (idx p 0) x)) (== (idx p 1) y)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f p)))))
(lemma rev_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges f p)
    (== (len q) (len p))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))) (== (idx q i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let j int (- (- (len p) 2) k))
    (assert (== (idx q k) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (edge_in_set f (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (call edge_sym f (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected f x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected f y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f p)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i)))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_at f p q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))
    (assert (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) y) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges f q)))))
(lemma cat_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges f p)
    (path_follows_edges f r)
    (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len r) 0))
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx r 0))
    (== (len s) (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))) (== (idx s i) (idx p i))))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= (len p) i) (< i (len s))) (== (idx s i) (idx r (+ (- i (len p)) 1)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len s) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f (idx s k) (idx s (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx s (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set f (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
        (assert (== (idx s k) (idx r m)))
        (assert (== (idx s (+ k 1)) (idx r (+ m 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set f (idx r m) (idx r (+ m 1))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected f x y) (edges_connected f y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected f x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f p)))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) y) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges f r)))
    (ghost-let s (seq int) (seq-build (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1) (fn (i) (if (< i (len p)) (idx p i) (idx r (+ (- i (len p)) 1))))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_at f p r s k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f s))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) z))
    (assert (and (and (> (len s) 0) (and (== (idx s 0) x) (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges f s)))))
(lemma mono_at (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (sub f1 f2) (path_follows_edges f1 p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f2 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body (assert (edge_in_set f1 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (sub f1 f2) (edges_connected f1 x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected f2 x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f1 p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call mono_at f1 f2 p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f2 p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges f2 p)))))
(lemma sub_prefix_at (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (prefix_of f1 f2) (edge_in_set f1 u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f2 u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f1)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f1 e) 0) u) (== (get (idx f1 e) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx f1 e) 0) v) (== (get (idx f1 e) 1) u)))))
    (assert (== (idx f2 e) (idx f1 e)))))
(lemma sub_prefix (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (prefix_of f1 f2))
  (ensures (sub f1 f2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call sub_prefix_at f1 f2 u v))))
(lemma prefix_push (params (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (prefix_of t0 (concat t0 (seq-lit e))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t0 (seq-lit e)))
    (assert (== (len t1) (+ (len t0) 1)))
    (assert (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len t0))) (== (idx t1 q) (idx t0 q)))))))
(lemma seg_conn (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (d int) (m int))
  (requires (seg_in f p d) (and (and (<= 0 d) (<= d m)) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected f (idx p d) (idx p m)))
  (decreases (- m d))
  (body
    (if (== m d)
      (call conn_refl f (idx p d))
      (block
        (call seg_conn f p d (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set f (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_edge f (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))
        (call conn_trans f (idx p d) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))))))
(lemma out_at (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (iset int)) (a int) (b int)
                      (p (seq int)) (d int) (i int))
  (requires (except f1 f2 a b) (crosses s a b) (path_follows_edges f1 p) (outside s p d)
            (and (and (<= d i) (<= 0 i)) (< i (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set f2 (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set f1 (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
    (assert (not (contains s (idx p i))))
    (assert (not (contains s (idx p (+ i 1)))))
    (assert (or (edge_in_set f2 (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1)))
                (or (and (== (idx p i) a) (== (idx p (+ i 1)) b)) (and (== (idx p i) b) (== (idx p (+ i 1)) a)))))))
(lemma out_seg (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (iset int)) (a int) (b int)
                       (p (seq int)) (d int))
  (requires (except f1 f2 a b) (crosses s a b) (path_follows_edges f1 p) (outside s p d))
  (ensures (seg_in f2 p d))
  (body (forall ((i int)) (call out_at f1 f2 s a b p d i))))
(lemma last_in (params (s (iset int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (contains s (idx p 0)) (not (contains s (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
            (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len p))) (outside s p m))
  (ensures (exists ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< (+ c 1) (len p))) (and (contains s (idx p c)) (outside s p (+ c 1))))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (contains s (idx p (- m 1)))
      (block
        (assert (< m (len p)))
        (assert (outside s p (+ (- m 1) 1)))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (+ (- m 1) 1) (len p)))
                     (and (contains s (idx p (- m 1))) (outside s p (+ (- m 1) 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (> m 1))
        (assert (outside s p (- m 1)))
        (call last_in s p (- m 1))))))
(lemma reroute (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (r (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (except f1 f2 a b) (edges_connected f2 a b) (path_follows_edges f1 r) (> (len r) 0)
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len r))))
  (ensures (edges_connected f2 (idx r 0) (idx r m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call conn_refl f2 (idx r 0))
      (block
        (call reroute f1 f2 a b r (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set f1 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m)))
        (assert (or (edge_in_set f2 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m))
                    (or (and (== (idx r (- m 1)) a) (== (idx r m) b)) (and (== (idx r (- m 1)) b) (== (idx r m) a)))))
        (if (edge_in_set f2 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m))
          (call conn_edge f2 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m))
          (if (== (idx r (- m 1)) a) (block) (call conn_sym f2 a b)))
        (assert (edges_connected f2 (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m)))
        (call conn_trans f2 (idx r 0) (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m))))))
(lemma qspan_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                        (a int) (b int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g f1) (except f1 f2 a b) (edges_connected f2 a b)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))))
  (ensures (edges_connected f2 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected f1 u v))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) u) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges f1 r)))
    (call reroute f1 f2 a b r (- (len r) 1))))
(lemma qs_at (params (pt (seq (tuple int int int))) (qt (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int))
                     (k int) (j int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (swapped pt qt e k j) (edge_in_set pt u v))
  (ensures (or (edge_in_set qt u v)
               (or (and (== u (get (idx pt j) 0)) (== v (get (idx pt j) 1)))
                   (and (== u (get (idx pt j) 1)) (== v (get (idx pt j) 0))))))
  (body
    (obtain ((t2 int)) (and (and (<= 0 t2) (< t2 (len pt)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx pt t2) 0) u) (== (get (idx pt t2) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx pt t2) 0) v) (== (get (idx pt t2) 1) u)))))
    (if (== t2 j)
      (block)
      (if (== t2 k)
        (block (assert (== (idx qt j) (idx pt k))) (assert (edge_in_set qt u v)))
        (block (assert (== (idx qt t2) (idx pt t2))) (assert (edge_in_set qt u v)))))))
(lemma qv_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (pt (seq (tuple int int int)))
                     (qt (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int) (j int) (q int))
  (requires (swapped pt qt e k j) (== (len t) (len pt)) (== e (idx t k))
            (are_valid_edges g t) (are_valid_edges g pt) (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len qt))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx qt q) 0) (get (idx qt q) 1) (get (idx qt q) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== q k)
      (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1) (get (idx t k) 2)))
      (if (== q j)
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx pt k) 0) (get (idx pt k) 1) (get (idx pt k) 2)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx pt q) 0) (get (idx pt q) 1) (get (idx pt q) 2)))))))
(lemma valid_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (wfv g) (are_valid_edges g t) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx t k) 0)) (< (get (idx t k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx t k) 1)) (< (get (idx t k) 1) (len g)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1) (get (idx t k) 2)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx t k) 0)) (< (get (idx t k) 0) (len g)))
                                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (get (idx t k) 0))))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t k) 0)) i) 0) (get (idx t k) 1))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t k) 0)) i) 1) (get (idx t k) 2)))))))
(lemma tw_point (params (s1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (== (len s2) (len s1)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s1)))
            (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len s1))) (!= q i)) (== (idx s2 q) (idx s1 q)))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight s2) (+ (- (total_weight s1) (get (idx s1 i) 2)) (get (idx s2 i) 2))))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight s1) (+ (get (idx s1 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s1 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight s2) (+ (get (idx s2 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s2 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop s2 1)) (len (drop s1 1))))
        (assert (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (drop s1 1)))) (== (idx (drop s2 1) q) (idx (drop s1 1) q)))))
        (assert (== (drop s2 1) (drop s1 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop s2 1)) (len (drop s1 1))))
        (assert (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (drop s1 1)))) (!= q (- i 1)))
                                      (== (idx (drop s2 1) q) (idx (drop s1 1) q)))))
        (call tw_point (drop s1 1) (drop s2 1) (- i 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop s1 1) (- i 1)) (idx s1 i)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop s2 1) (- i 1)) (idx s2 i)))
        (assert (== (idx s2 0) (idx s1 0)))))))
(lemma qt_conn
  (params (s (iset int)) (fk (seq (tuple int int int))) (pt (seq (tuple int int int))) (qt (seq (tuple int int int)))
          (e (tuple int int int)) (k int) (j int) (ea int) (eb int) (p (seq int)) (c int))
  (requires
    (spans s fk)
    (and (contains s ea) (not (contains s eb)))
    (sub fk qt)
    (swapped pt qt e k j)
    (== (idx qt k) e)
    (or (and (== ea (get e 0)) (== eb (get e 1))) (and (== ea (get e 1)) (== eb (get e 0))))
    (path_follows_edges pt p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) eb)
    (and (<= 0 c) (< (+ c 1) (len p)))
    (contains s (idx p c))
    (outside s p (+ c 1))
    (except pt qt (get (idx pt j) 0) (get (idx pt j) 1))
    (crosses s (get (idx pt j) 0) (get (idx pt j) 1))
    (or (and (== (get (idx pt j) 0) (idx p c)) (== (get (idx pt j) 1) (idx p (+ c 1))))
        (and (== (get (idx pt j) 0) (idx p (+ c 1))) (== (get (idx pt j) 1) (idx p c)))))
  (ensures (edges_connected qt (get (idx pt j) 0) (get (idx pt j) 1)))
  (body
    (ghost-let a1 int (get (idx pt j) 0))
    (ghost-let b1 int (get (idx pt j) 1))
    (ghost-let pc int (idx p c))
    (ghost-let pd int (idx p (+ c 1)))
    (assert (not (contains s pd)))
    (assert (edges_connected fk 0 pc))
    (assert (edges_connected fk 0 ea))
    (call conn_mono fk qt 0 pc)
    (call conn_mono fk qt 0 ea)
    (call conn_sym qt 0 pc)
    (call conn_trans qt pc 0 ea)
    (assert (edge_in_set qt ea eb))
    (call conn_edge qt ea eb)
    (call conn_trans qt pc ea eb)
    (call out_seg pt qt s a1 b1 p (+ c 1))
    (call seg_conn qt p (+ c 1) (- (len p) 1))
    (call conn_sym qt pd eb)
    (call conn_trans qt pc eb pd)
    (if (== a1 pc) (block) (call conn_sym qt pc pd))))
(lemma opt_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (cuts (seq (iset int)))
                        (pt (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires
    (wfv g)
    (are_valid_edges g t)
    (== (len t) (- (len g) 1))
    (history g t cuts)
    (is_spanning_tree g pt)
    (== (len pt) (len t))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len t)))
    (agree pt t k))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight pt)))
  (decreases (- (len t) k))
  (body
    (if (< k (len t))
      (block
        (assert (step_ok g t cuts k))
        (ghost-let s (iset int) (idx cuts k))
        (ghost-let e (tuple int int int) (idx t k))
        (ghost-let fk (seq (tuple int int int)) (take t k))
        (assert (crosses s (get e 0) (get e 1)))
        (assert (light g s (get e 2)))
        (assert (contains s 0))
        (assert (inside s fk))
        (assert (spans s fk))
        (ghost-let ea int (if (contains s (get e 0)) (get e 0) (get e 1)))
        (ghost-let eb int (if (contains s (get e 0)) (get e 1) (get e 0)))
        (assert (and (contains s ea) (not (contains s eb))))
        (call valid_range g t k)
        (assert (is_spanning g pt))
        (assert (edges_connected pt ea eb))
        (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) ea) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) eb))) (path_follows_edges pt p)))
        (assert (outside s p (len p)))
        (call last_in s p (len p))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< (+ c 1) (len p))) (and (contains s (idx p c)) (outside s p (+ c 1)))))
        (ghost-let pc int (idx p c))
        (ghost-let pd int (idx p (+ c 1)))
        (assert (not (contains s pd)))
        (assert (edge_in_set pt pc pd))
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len pt)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx pt j) 0) pc) (== (get (idx pt j) 1) pd))
              (and (== (get (idx pt j) 0) pd) (== (get (idx pt j) 1) pc)))))
        (ghost-let a1 int (get (idx pt j) 0))
        (ghost-let b1 int (get (idx pt j) 1))
        (assert (crosses s a1 b1))
        (if (< j k)
          (block
            (assert (== (idx pt j) (idx t j)))
            (assert (== (idx fk j) (idx t j)))
            (assert (and (contains s (get (idx fk j) 0)) (contains s (get (idx fk j) 1))))
            (assert false))
          (block))
        (assert (are_valid_edges g pt))
        (assert (has_edge g a1 b1 (get (idx pt j) 2)))

  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (!= i j))
  (ensures (!= (tg g u i) (tg g u j)))
  (body (assert (== (tg g u i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (assert (== (tg g u j) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))
(lemma cap_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (tg g u i)) (< (tg g u i) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (cp g u i)) (<= (cp g u i) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_capacity g u (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))))
(lemma cap_len (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))

(lemma cap_p2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))

    (if (has_capacity g u v x)

        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) x))))
        (assert (rowok g (idx c u) u (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (and (== (tg g u i) v) (== (cp g u i) x)))
        (assert (== (ati (idx c u) v) x))
        (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (ati (idx c u) v))))

(lemma cap_p3 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow c u v)) (<= (get_flow c u v) 100000))
           (=> (> (get_flow c u v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))

  (body

        (assert (rowok g (idx c u) u (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (ati (idx c u) v)))
        (if (!= (ati (idx c u) v) 0)

(lemma capok_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))

  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call cap_len g c u))
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (x int)) (call cap_p2 g c u v x))

(lemma fbnd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
  (ensures
    (and (and (== (len c) (len g)) (== (len f) (len g)))
         (and (and (== (len (idx c a)) (len g)) (== (len (idx c b)) (len g)))
              (and (== (len (idx f a)) (len g)) (== (len (idx f b)) (len g)))))
    (and (== (get_flow c a b) (idx (idx c a) b))
         (and (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)) (== (get_flow f b a) (idx (idx f b) a))))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow f a b)) (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow c a b))) (<= (get_flow c a b) 100000))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow f b a)) (<= (get_flow f b a) (get_flow c b a))) (<= (get_flow c b a) 100000)))
  (body (assert (sqm c (len g))) (assert (sqm f (len g)))))

(lemma csum_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))

(lemma c1a (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (tg g u j) m))))

(lemma c1b (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u)))) (== (tg g u i) m))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (+ (tsum g f u k m) (get_flow f u m))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (== (tg g u i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (if (== (- k 1) i)
      (block
        (forall ((j int)) (call tg_ne g u i j))
        (call c1a g f u (- k 1) m))
      (block
        (call tg_ne g u i (- k 1))

(lemma c2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))) (rowz g f u))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rsum f u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call c2 g f u (- m 1))
        (if (istg g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- m 1))))
            (assert (== (tg g u i) (- m 1)))
            (call c1b g f u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1) i))
          (block
            (assert (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))
            (call c1a g f u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)))))
      (call c_base g f u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma row_conv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (rowz g f u))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rsum f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (csum f u (len g))))
  (body (call c0 g f u (len (idx g u))) (call c2 g f u (len g)) (call csum_link g f u (len g))))

(lemma wdec (params (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))

  (requires (== (len mk) n) (ins mk s) (not (ins mk t)) (mcons f s t n))
  (ensures (== (- (rsum f s n) (csum f s n)) (- (ot f mk n n) (it f mk n n))))
  (body (call wcons f mk s t n n) (call wdec f mk n n) (call swap f mk n n)))
(lemma mono_rt (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int) (z bool))
  (requires (>= m 0)
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) (not (ins mk v)))
      (and (<= (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f2 u v)) (=> z (== (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f2 u v)))))))
  (ensures (<= (rt f1 mk u m) (rt f2 mk u m)) (=> z (== (rt f1 mk u m) (rt f2 mk u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call mono_rt f1 f2 mk u (- m 1) z) (block))))
(lemma mono_ot (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int) (z bool))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u a)) (ins mk u)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (ins mk v))))
          (and (<= (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f2 u v)) (=> z (== (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f2 u v)))))))
  (ensures (<= (ot f1 mk a n) (ot f2 mk a n)) (=> z (== (ot f1 mk a n) (ot f2 mk a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call mono_ot f1 f2 mk (- a 1) n z)
      (if (ins mk (- a 1)) (call mono_rt f1 f2 mk (- a 1) n z) (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma ct_range (params (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int) (z bool))
  (requires (>= m 0)
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (not (ins mk k)))
      (and (<= 0 (get_flow f k u)) (=> z (== (get_flow f k u) 0))))))
  (ensures (>= (ct f mk u m) 0) (=> z (== (ct f mk u m) 0)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call ct_range f mk u (- m 1) z) (block))))
(lemma it_range (params (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int) (z bool))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)
    (forall ((u int) (k int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u a)) (ins mk u)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k n)) (not (ins mk k))))
          (and (<= 0 (get_flow f k u)) (=> z (== (get_flow f k u) 0))))))

(lemma ot_single (params (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (s int) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (ins mk s) (forall ((u int)) (=> (ins mk u) (== u s))))

(lemma vbound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (mcons f s t (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t) (<= (len g) 1000))
  (ensures (<= (- (rsum f s (len g)) (csum f s (len g))) 100000000))
  (body
    (ghost-let m1 (seq int) (seq-build (len g) (fn (j) (if (== j s) 1 0))))
    (assert (ins m1 s))
    (assert (not (ins m1 t)))
    (call cut f m1 s t (len g))
    (call mono_ot f c m1 (len g) (len g) false)
    (call it_range f m1 (len g) (len g) false)
    (call ot_single c m1 s (len g) (len g))
    (call rt_cap c m1 s (len g))))

  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
    (and (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
         (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0) (exists ((x int)) (and (has_capacity g u v x) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) x)))))))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))
    (assert (=> (> (get_flow f u v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v))))))
(lemma fin_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (mcons f s t (len g)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (- (rsum f s (len g)) (csum f s (len g)))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call rc_pt g c f u v))
    (forall ((u int)) (call frow g c f u))
    (forall ((u int)) (call row_conv g f u))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call frow g c f s)
    (call row_conv g f s)))

  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures (rowz g f u))
  (body (assert (respects_capacity g f))))

  (requires (wfg g) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (csum f u (len g)) (rsum f u (len g))))
  (body (call rowz_valid g f s t u) (call row_conv g f u) (assert (is_conserved g f s t))))
(lemma cap_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (capok g c) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures (forall ((u int) (v int)) (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))))
  (body (assert (respects_capacity g f))))
(lemma opt_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (f (seq (seq int)))
                       (s int) (t int) (fv int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok g c) (== (len mk) (len g)) (ins mk s) (not (ins mk t))
            (== fv (ot c mk (len g) (len g))) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g f s) fv))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call cons_pt g f s t u))
    (assert (mcons f s t (len g)))
    (call rowz_valid g f s t s)
    (call row_conv g f s)
    (call cut f mk s t (len g))
    (call cap_le g c f s t)
    (call mono_ot f c mk (len g) (len g) false)
    (call it_range f mk (len g) (len g) false)))

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (ghost-let gg (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_view graph)
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== n (len gg)))
    (assert (<= n 1000))
    (let-mut cm (vec (vec i64)) (vec-new))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (capok_upto gg cm u))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (assert (== deg (len (idx gg u))))
      (let-mut row (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j1) 0)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (rowok gg row u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
        (assert (and (== (get e 0) (tg gg u i)) (== (get e 1) (cp gg u i))))
        (call cap_entry gg u i)
        (forall ((k1 int)) (call tg_ne gg u i k1))
        (set-idx row (get e 0) (get e 1))
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (push cm row)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call capok_intro gg cm)
    (let-mut fm (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j2) (seq-build n (fn (j3) 0)))))
    (assert (forall ((a int) (b int)) (== (get_flow fm a b) 0)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call z_sums fm w n))
    (let-mut val i64 0)
    (let-mut go bool true)
    (let-mut mk (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (let-mut par (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (ghost-let-mut ord (seq int) (seq-lit))
    (ghost-let-mut cnt int 0)
    (while go
      (invariant (capok gg cm))

(lemma rs_p2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int))

(lemma rs_p3 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))

(lemma rs_p4 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))

(lemma rowok_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))

(lemma cu_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (row (seq int)) (u int))

(lemma cap_p2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))

        (assert (rowok g (idx c u) u (len (idx g u))))

(lemma cap_p3 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))

  (body

(lemma fbnd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
  (ensures
    (and (and (== (len c) (len g)) (== (len f) (len g)))
         (and (and (== (len (idx c a)) (len g)) (== (len (idx c b)) (len g)))
              (and (== (len (idx f a)) (len g)) (== (len (idx f b)) (len g)))))
    (and (== (get_flow c a b) (idx (idx c a) b))
         (and (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)) (== (get_flow f b a) (idx (idx f b) a))))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow f a b)) (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow c a b))) (<= (get_flow c a b) 100000))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow f b a)) (<= (get_flow f b a) (get_flow c b a))) (<= (get_flow c b a) 100000)))
  (body (assert (sqm c (len g))) (assert (sqm f (len g)))))

(lemma spar_pt (params (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))
                       (c int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 c s n) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y c)
            (not (ins m0 y)) (ins m0 x))
  (ensures (=> (ins m1 v)
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx o1 v)) (< (idx o1 v) (+ c 1)))
         (=> (!= v s) (and (and (<= 0 (idx p1 v)) (< (idx p1 v) n))
                           (and (ins m1 (idx p1 v)) (< (idx o1 (idx p1 v)) (idx o1 v))))))))
  (body
    (if (ins m1 v)
      (if (== v y)
        (block
          (assert (ins m0 s))
          (assert (!= x y))
          (assert (== (idx o1 y) c))
          (assert (== (idx p1 y) x))
          (assert (ins m1 x))
          (assert (== (idx o1 x) (idx o0 x)))
          (assert (and (<= 0 (idx o0 x)) (< (idx o0 x) c))))
        (block
          (assert (ins m0 v))
          (assert (== (idx o1 v) (idx o0 v)))
          (if (!= v s)
            (block
              (assert (== (idx p1 v) (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (ins m0 (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (!= (idx p0 v) y))
              (assert (ins m1 (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (== (idx o1 (idx p0 v)) (idx o0 (idx p0 v))))
              (assert (< (idx o0 (idx p0 v)) (idx o0 v))))
            (block))))
      (block))))
(lemma spar_step (params (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))
                         (c int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 c s n) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y c)
            (not (ins m0 y)) (ins m0 x))
  (ensures (spar m1 p1 o1 (+ c 1) s n))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call spar_pt m0 p0 o0 m1 p1 o1 c s n x y v))
    (assert (ins m0 s))
    (assert (ins m1 s))
    (assert (== (idx o1 s) 0))))
(lemma sres_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int))
                       (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (k int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 k s n) (sres c f m0 p0 o0 s k) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y k)

  (body

        (assert (ins m0 v))
        (assert (< (idx o0 v) k))
        (assert (== (ati o0 v) (idx o0 v))))
      (block))))
(lemma sres_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int))

  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 k s n) (sres c f m0 p0 o0 s k) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y k)

  (ensures (sres c f m1 p1 o1 s (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((v int)) (call sres_pt c f m0 p0 o0 m1 p1 o1 k s n x y v))))
(lemma rcl_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (rclosed c f mk x y) (=> (not (ins mk y)) (<= (res c f x y) 0)))

  (requires (closed c f mk x n) (=> (ins mk x) (rclosed c f mk x n)))

(lemma cl_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (n int) (z bool))
  (requires (== y n) (=> z (closed c f mk x n)) (=> z (=> (ins mk x) (rclosed c f mk x y))))
  (ensures (=> z (closed c f mk (+ x 1) n)))
  (body
    (if z

(lemma sat_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flowok c f n) (closed c f mk n n))

(lemma csum_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))

  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (len g)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)

(lemma c1a (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (tg g u j) m))))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (tsum g f u k m)))

(lemma c1b (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u)))) (== (tg g u i) m))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (+ (tsum g f u k m) (get_flow f u m))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (== (tg g u i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (if (== (- k 1) i)
      (block
        (forall ((j int)) (call tg_ne g u i j))
        (call c1a g f u (- k 1) m))
      (block
        (call tg_ne g u i (- k 1))
        (call c1b g f u (- k 1) m i)))))
(lemma c2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))) (rowz g f u))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rsum f u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call c2 g f u (- m 1))
        (if (istg g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- m 1))))
            (assert (== (tg g u i) (- m 1)))
            (call c1b g f u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1) i))
          (block
            (assert (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))
            (call c1a g f u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)))))
      (call c_base g f u (len (idx g u))))))

  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (rowz g f u))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rsum f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (csum f u (len g))))
  (body (call c0 g f u (len (idx g u))) (call c2 g f u (len g)) (call csum_link g f u (len g))))

(lemma pu_rs (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (m int))

                         (=> (not (istg g u v)) (== (get_flow c u v) 0))))))))
(ghost-fn flowok ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (sqm f n)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))))))
(ghost-fn mcons ((f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))) (== (csum f u n) (rsum f u n))))))
(ghost-fn res ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (+ (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow f u v)) (get_flow f v u))))
(ghost-fn ins ((mk (seq int)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len mk))) (== (idx mk u) 1))))
(ghost-fn closed ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u a)) (ins mk u)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (ins mk v))))
        (<= (res c f u v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rclosed ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v y)) (not (ins mk v))) (<= (res c f x v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn spar ((mk (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (cnt int) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (== (len mk) n) (== (len par) n)) (and (== (len ord) n) (ins mk s)))
    (and (== (idx ord s) 0)
      (forall ((v int)) (=> (ins mk v)
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx ord v)) (< (idx ord v) cnt))
             (=> (!= v s) (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
                               (and (ins mk (idx par v)) (< (idx ord (idx par v)) (idx ord v))))))))))))
(ghost-fn sres ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (ins mk v) (!= v s)) (<= (ati ord v) lim)) (> (res c f (ati par v) v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn unm ((mk (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (unm mk (- m 1)) (if (ins mk (- m 1)) 0 1)))))
(ghost-fn pupd ((f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len f2) (len f)) (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (== (len (idx f2 u)) (len (idx f u))))))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a)))))
      (forall ((u int) (v int)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (+ (get_flow f u v) (if (and (== u a) (== v b)) d 0))))))))
(ghost-fn hh ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (and (ins mk u) (ins mk v)) (get_flow f u v) 0)))
(ghost-fn rr ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rr f mk u (- m 1)) (hh f mk u (- m 1))))))
(ghost-fn kk ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (v int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (kk f mk v (- m 1)) (hh f mk (- m 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn rt ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rt f mk u (- m 1)) (if (ins mk (- m 1)) 0 (get_flow f u (- m 1)))))))
(ghost-fn ct ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (ct f mk u (- m 1)) (if (ins mk (- m 1)) 0 (get_flow f (- m 1) u))))))
(ghost-fn dr ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dr f mk (- a 1) b) (rr f mk (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn dk ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (dk f mk a (- b 1)) (kk f mk (- b 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn ws ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
    (+ (ws f mk (- a 1) n) (if (ins mk (- a 1)) (- (rsum f (- a 1) n) (csum f (- a 1) n)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn ot ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (ot f mk (- a 1) n) (if (ins mk (- a 1)) (rt f mk (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn it ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (it f mk (- a 1) n) (if (ins mk (- a 1)) (ct f mk (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn upd1 ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))

(lemma tg_ne (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (!= i j))
  (ensures (!= (tg g u i) (tg g u j)))
  (body (assert (== (tg g u i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (assert (== (tg g u j) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))
(lemma cap_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (tg g u i)) (< (tg g u i) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (cp g u i)) (<= (cp g u i) 100000)))

(lemma ati_upd (params (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (a int) (x int) (v int))
  (requires (upd1 r0 r1 a x))
  (ensures (== (ati r1 v) (if (== v a) x (ati r0 v))))
  (body))
(lemma rs_p2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rowok g r0 u i) (upd1 r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (ati r1 v)) (<= (ati r1 v) 100000)))
  (body
    (call cap_entry g u i)
    (call ati_upd r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i) v)
    (assert (and (<= 0 (ati r0 v)) (<= (ati r0 v) 100000)))))
(lemma rs_p3 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rowok g r0 u i) (upd1 r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ i 1))) (== (ati r1 (tg g u j)) (cp g u j))))
  (body
    (call ati_upd r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i) (tg g u j))
    (if (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
      (block (call tg_ne g u i j) (assert (== (ati r0 (tg g u j)) (cp g u j))))
      (block))))
(lemma rs_p4 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rowok g r0 u i) (upd1 r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))
  (ensures (=> (!= (ati r1 v) 0) (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ i 1))) (== (tg g u j) v)))))
  (body
    (call ati_upd r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i) v)
    (if (== v (tg g u i))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ i 1))) (== (tg g u i) v)))
      (if (!= (ati r0 v) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((jw int)) (and (and (<= 0 jw) (< jw i)) (== (tg g u jw) v)))
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 jw) (< jw (+ i 1))) (== (tg g u jw) v))))
        (block)))))
(lemma rowok_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rowok g r0 u i) (upd1 r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))
  (ensures (rowok g r1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call rs_p2 g r0 r1 u i v))
    (forall ((j int)) (call rs_p3 g r0 r1 u i j))
    (forall ((v2 int)) (call rs_p4 g r0 r1 u i v2))
    (assert (== (len r1) (len g)))))
(lemma cu_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (row (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (capok_upto g c0 u) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (rowok g row u (len (idx g u)))
            (== c1 (concat c0 (seq-lit row))))
  (ensures (capok_upto g c1 (+ u 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len c1) (+ u 1)))
    (assert (== (idx c1 u) row))
    (assert (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w u)) (== (idx c1 w) (idx c0 w)))))))
(lemma cap_len (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (len (idx c u)) (len g)))
  (body (assert (rowok g (idx c u) u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma cap_p2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (has_capacity g u v x) (== (get_flow c u v) x)))
  (body
    (if (has_capacity g u v x)
      (block
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) x))))
        (assert (rowok g (idx c u) u (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (and (== (tg g u i) v) (== (cp g u i) x)))
        (assert (== (ati (idx c u) v) x))
        (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (ati (idx c u) v))))

(lemma cap_p3 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow c u v)) (<= (get_flow c u v) 100000))
           (=> (> (get_flow c u v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
           (=> (not (istg g u v)) (== (get_flow c u v) 0)))
  (body

  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))

    (forall ((u int) (v int) (x int)) (call cap_p2 g c u v x))

(lemma fbnd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
  (ensures
    (and (and (== (len c) (len g)) (== (len f) (len g)))
         (and (and (== (len (idx c a)) (len g)) (== (len (idx c b)) (len g)))
              (and (== (len (idx f a)) (len g)) (== (len (idx f b)) (len g)))))
    (and (== (get_flow c a b) (idx (idx c a) b))
         (and (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)) (== (get_flow f b a) (idx (idx f b) a))))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow f a b)) (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow c a b))) (<= (get_flow c a b) 100000))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow f b a)) (<= (get_flow f b a) (get_flow c b a))) (<= (get_flow c b a) 100000)))
  (body (assert (sqm c (len g))) (assert (sqm f (len g)))))

(lemma spar_pt (params (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))
                       (c int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 c s n) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y c)
            (not (ins m0 y)) (ins m0 x))
  (ensures (=> (ins m1 v)
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx o1 v)) (< (idx o1 v) (+ c 1)))
         (=> (!= v s) (and (and (<= 0 (idx p1 v)) (< (idx p1 v) n))
                           (and (ins m1 (idx p1 v)) (< (idx o1 (idx p1 v)) (idx o1 v))))))))
  (body
    (if (ins m1 v)
      (if (== v y)
        (block
          (assert (ins m0 s))
          (assert (!= x y))
          (assert (== (idx o1 y) c))
          (assert (== (idx p1 y) x))
          (assert (ins m1 x))
          (assert (== (idx o1 x) (idx o0 x)))
          (assert (and (<= 0 (idx o0 x)) (< (idx o0 x) c))))
        (block
          (assert (ins m0 v))
          (assert (== (idx o1 v) (idx o0 v)))
          (if (!= v s)
            (block
              (assert (== (idx p1 v) (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (ins m0 (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (!= (idx p0 v) y))
              (assert (ins m1 (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (== (idx o1 (idx p0 v)) (idx o0 (idx p0 v))))
              (assert (< (idx o0 (idx p0 v)) (idx o0 v))))
            (block))))
      (block))))
(lemma spar_step (params (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))
                         (c int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 c s n) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y c)
            (not (ins m0 y)) (ins m0 x))
  (ensures (spar m1 p1 o1 (+ c 1) s n))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call spar_pt m0 p0 o0 m1 p1 o1 c s n x y v))
    (assert (ins m0 s))
    (assert (ins m1 s))
    (assert (== (idx o1 s) 0))))
(lemma sres_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int))
                       (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (k int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 k s n) (sres c f m0 p0 o0 s k) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y k)
            (> (res c f x y) 0))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (ins m1 v) (!= v s)) (<= (ati o1 v) (+ k 1))) (> (res c f (ati p1 v) v) 0)))
  (body
    (call ati_upd p0 p1 y x v)
    (call ati_upd o0 o1 y k v)
    (if (and (ins m1 v) (!= v y))
      (block
        (assert (ins m0 v))
        (assert (< (idx o0 v) k))
        (assert (== (ati o0 v) (idx o0 v))))
      (block))))
(lemma sres_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int))
                         (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (k int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 k s n) (sres c f m0 p0 o0 s k) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y k)
            (> (res c f x y) 0))
  (ensures (sres c f m1 p1 o1 s (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((v int)) (call sres_pt c f m0 p0 o0 m1 p1 o1 k s n x y v))))
(lemma rcl_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (rclosed c f mk x y) (=> (not (ins mk y)) (<= (res c f x y) 0)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (+ y 1))) (not (ins mk v))) (<= (res c f x v) 0)))

(lemma rcl_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (z bool))
  (requires (=> z (rclosed c f mk x y)) (=> (not (ins mk y)) (<= (res c f x y) 0)))

  (requires (closed c f mk x n) (=> (ins mk x) (rclosed c f mk x n)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (+ x 1))) (ins mk u)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (ins mk v))))
               (<= (res c f u v) 0)))
  (body))
(lemma cl_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (n int) (z bool))
  (requires (== y n) (=> z (closed c f mk x n)) (=> z (=> (ins mk x) (rclosed c f mk x y))))
  (ensures (=> z (closed c f mk (+ x 1) n)))
  (body
    (if z
      (block
        (assert (=> (ins mk x) (rclosed c f mk x n)))
        (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call cl_pt c f mk x n u v)))
      (block))))
(lemma sat_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flowok c f n) (closed c f mk n n))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (ins mk u)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (ins mk v))))
               (and (== (get_flow c u v) (get_flow f u v)) (== (get_flow f v u) 0))))

(lemma csum_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))

  (decreases m)

(lemma c0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (len g)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call c0 g f u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (tg g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma c1a (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (tg g u j) m))))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (tsum g f u k m)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call c1a g f u (- k 1) m) (block))))
(lemma c1b (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u)))) (== (tg g u i) m))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (+ (tsum g f u k m) (get_flow f u m))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (== (tg g u i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (if (== (- k 1) i)
      (block
        (forall ((j int)) (call tg_ne g u i j))
        (call c1a g f u (- k 1) m))
      (block
        (call tg_ne g u i (- k 1))
        (call c1b g f u (- k 1) m i)))))

(lemma rs_p3 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (j int))

(lemma rs_p4 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))

(lemma rowok_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))

(lemma fbnd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
  (ensures
    (and (and (== (len c) (len g)) (== (len f) (len g)))

(lemma spar_pt (params (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))

  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 c s n) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y c)

    (and (and (<= 0 (idx o1 v)) (< (idx o1 v) (+ c 1)))

  (body
    (if (ins m1 v)

        (block
          (assert (ins m0 s))
          (assert (!= x y))
          (assert (== (idx o1 y) c))
          (assert (== (idx p1 y) x))
          (assert (ins m1 x))
          (assert (== (idx o1 x) (idx o0 x)))
          (assert (and (<= 0 (idx o0 x)) (< (idx o0 x) c))))
        (block

              (assert (ins m1 (idx p0 v)))

(lemma spar_step (params (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))

(lemma sres_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int))
                       (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (k int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int) (v int))

  (body (call c_out g f u (len (idx g u))) (call c2 g f u (len g)) (call csum_link g f u (len g))))

(lemma mono_ot (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int) (z bool))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)

      (forall ((v int)) (=> (ins mk v)
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx ord v)) (< (idx ord v) cnt))
             (=> (!= v s) (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
                               (and (ins mk (idx par v)) (< (idx ord (idx par v)) (idx ord v))))))))))))
(ghost-fn sres ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (ins mk v) (!= v s)) (<= (ati ord v) lim)) (> (res c f (ati par v) v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn unm ((mk (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (unm mk (- m 1)) (if (ins mk (- m 1)) 0 1)))))
(ghost-fn pupd ((f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len f2) (len f)) (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (== (len (idx f2 u)) (len (idx f u))))))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a)))))
      (forall ((u int) (v int)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (+ (get_flow f u v) (if (and (== u a) (== v b)) d 0))))))))
(ghost-fn hh ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (and (ins mk u) (ins mk v)) (get_flow f u v) 0)))
(ghost-fn rr ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rr f mk u (- m 1)) (hh f mk u (- m 1))))))
(ghost-fn kk ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (v int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (kk f mk v (- m 1)) (hh f mk (- m 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn rt ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rt f mk u (- m 1)) (if (ins mk (- m 1)) 0 (get_flow f u (- m 1)))))))
(ghost-fn ct ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (ct f mk u (- m 1)) (if (ins mk (- m 1)) 0 (get_flow f (- m 1) u))))))
(ghost-fn dr ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dr f mk (- a 1) b) (rr f mk (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn dk ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (dk f mk a (- b 1)) (kk f mk (- b 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn ws ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
    (+ (ws f mk (- a 1) n) (if (ins mk (- a 1)) (- (rsum f (- a 1) n) (csum f (- a 1) n)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn ot ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (ot f mk (- a 1) n) (if (ins mk (- a 1)) (rt f mk (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn it ((f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (it f mk (- a 1) n) (if (ins mk (- a 1)) (ct f mk (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn upd1 ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))
