(lemma tg_ne (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (!= i j))
  (ensures (!= (tg g u i) (tg g u j)))
  (body (assert (== (tg g u i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (assert (== (tg g u j) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))
(lemma cap_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (tg g u i)) (< (tg g u i) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (cp g u i)) (<= (cp g u i) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_capacity g u (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))))
(lemma ati_upd (params (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (a int) (x int) (v int))
  (requires (upd1 r0 r1 a x))
  (ensures (== (ati r1 v) (if (== v a) x (ati r0 v))))
  (body))
(lemma rs_p2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rowok g r0 u i) (upd1 r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (ati r1 v)) (<= (ati r1 v) 100000)))
  (body
    (call cap_entry g u i)
    (call ati_upd r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i) v)
    (assert (and (<= 0 (ati r0 v)) (<= (ati r0 v) 100000)))))
(lemma rs_p3 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rowok g r0 u i) (upd1 r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ i 1))) (== (ati r1 (tg g u j)) (cp g u j))))
  (body
    (call ati_upd r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i) (tg g u j))
    (if (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
      (block (call tg_ne g u i j) (assert (== (ati r0 (tg g u j)) (cp g u j))))
      (block))))
(lemma rs_p4 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rowok g r0 u i) (upd1 r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))
  (ensures (=> (!= (ati r1 v) 0) (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ i 1))) (== (tg g u j) v)))))
  (body
    (call ati_upd r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i) v)
    (if (== v (tg g u i))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ i 1))) (== (tg g u i) v)))
      (if (!= (ati r0 v) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((jw int)) (and (and (<= 0 jw) (< jw i)) (== (tg g u jw) v)))
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 jw) (< jw (+ i 1))) (== (tg g u jw) v))))
        (block)))))
(lemma rowok_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rowok g r0 u i) (upd1 r0 r1 (tg g u i) (cp g u i)))
  (ensures (rowok g r1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call rs_p2 g r0 r1 u i v))
    (forall ((j int)) (call rs_p3 g r0 r1 u i j))
    (forall ((v2 int)) (call rs_p4 g r0 r1 u i v2))
    (assert (== (len r1) (len g)))))
(lemma cu_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (row (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (capok_upto g c0 u) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (rowok g row u (len (idx g u)))
            (== c1 (concat c0 (seq-lit row))))
  (ensures (capok_upto g c1 (+ u 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len c1) (+ u 1)))
    (assert (== (idx c1 u) row))
    (assert (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w u)) (== (idx c1 w) (idx c0 w)))))))
(lemma cap_len (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (len (idx c u)) (len g)))
  (body (assert (rowok g (idx c u) u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma cap_p2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (has_capacity g u v x) (== (get_flow c u v) x)))
  (body
    (if (has_capacity g u v x)
      (block
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) x))))
        (assert (rowok g (idx c u) u (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (and (== (tg g u i) v) (== (cp g u i) x)))
        (assert (== (ati (idx c u) v) x))
        (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (ati (idx c u) v))))
      (block))))
(lemma cap_p3 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow c u v)) (<= (get_flow c u v) 100000))
           (=> (> (get_flow c u v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
           (=> (not (istg g u v)) (== (get_flow c u v) 0)))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (block
        (assert (rowok g (idx c u) u (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (ati (idx c u) v)))
        (if (!= (ati (idx c u) v) 0)
          (block
            (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (== (tg g u j) v)))
            (assert (== (ati (idx c u) (tg g u j)) (cp g u j)))
            (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))
            (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) (cp g u j))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma capok_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok_upto g c (len g)))
  (ensures (capok g c))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call cap_len g c u))
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (x int)) (call cap_p2 g c u v x))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call cap_p3 g c u v))
    (assert (sqm c (len g)))))
(lemma fbnd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
  (ensures
    (and (and (== (len c) (len g)) (== (len f) (len g)))
         (and (and (== (len (idx c a)) (len g)) (== (len (idx c b)) (len g)))
              (and (== (len (idx f a)) (len g)) (== (len (idx f b)) (len g)))))
    (and (== (get_flow c a b) (idx (idx c a) b))
         (and (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)) (== (get_flow f b a) (idx (idx f b) a))))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow f a b)) (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow c a b))) (<= (get_flow c a b) 100000))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow f b a)) (<= (get_flow f b a) (get_flow c b a))) (<= (get_flow c b a) 100000)))
  (body (assert (sqm c (len g))) (assert (sqm f (len g)))))

(lemma ins_upd (params (m0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (y int))
  (requires (upd1 m0 m1 y 1))
  (ensures (ins m1 y) (forall ((j int)) (=> (!= j y) (== (ins m1 j) (ins m0 j)))))
  (body))
(lemma spar_pt (params (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))
                       (c int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 c s n) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y c)
            (not (ins m0 y)) (ins m0 x))
  (ensures (=> (ins m1 v)
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx o1 v)) (< (idx o1 v) (+ c 1)))
         (=> (!= v s) (and (and (<= 0 (idx p1 v)) (< (idx p1 v) n))
                           (and (ins m1 (idx p1 v)) (< (idx o1 (idx p1 v)) (idx o1 v))))))))
  (body
    (if (ins m1 v)
      (if (== v y)
        (block
          (assert (ins m0 s))
          (assert (!= x y))
          (assert (== (idx o1 y) c))
          (assert (== (idx p1 y) x))
          (assert (ins m1 x))
          (assert (== (idx o1 x) (idx o0 x)))
          (assert (and (<= 0 (idx o0 x)) (< (idx o0 x) c))))
        (block
          (assert (ins m0 v))
          (assert (== (idx o1 v) (idx o0 v)))
          (if (!= v s)
            (block
              (assert (== (idx p1 v) (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (ins m0 (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (!= (idx p0 v) y))
              (assert (ins m1 (idx p0 v)))
              (assert (== (idx o1 (idx p0 v)) (idx o0 (idx p0 v))))
              (assert (< (idx o0 (idx p0 v)) (idx o0 v))))
            (block))))
      (block))))
(lemma spar_step (params (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))
                         (c int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 c s n) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y c)
            (not (ins m0 y)) (ins m0 x))
  (ensures (spar m1 p1 o1 (+ c 1) s n))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call spar_pt m0 p0 o0 m1 p1 o1 c s n x y v))
    (assert (ins m0 s))
    (assert (ins m1 s))
    (assert (== (idx o1 s) 0))))
(lemma sres_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int))
                       (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (k int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 k s n) (sres c f m0 p0 o0 s k) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y k)
            (> (res c f x y) 0))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (ins m1 v) (!= v s)) (<= (ati o1 v) (+ k 1))) (> (res c f (ati p1 v) v) 0)))
  (body
    (call ati_upd p0 p1 y x v)
    (call ati_upd o0 o1 y k v)
    (if (and (ins m1 v) (!= v y))
      (block
        (assert (ins m0 v))
        (assert (< (idx o0 v) k))
        (assert (== (ati o0 v) (idx o0 v))))
      (block))))
(lemma sres_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int))
                         (m1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (k int) (s int) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (spar m0 p0 o0 k s n) (sres c f m0 p0 o0 s k) (upd1 m0 m1 y 1) (upd1 p0 p1 y x) (upd1 o0 o1 y k)
            (> (res c f x y) 0))
  (ensures (sres c f m1 p1 o1 s (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((v int)) (call sres_pt c f m0 p0 o0 m1 p1 o1 k s n x y v))))
(lemma rcl_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (rclosed c f mk x y) (=> (not (ins mk y)) (<= (res c f x y) 0)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (+ y 1))) (not (ins mk v))) (<= (res c f x v) 0)))
  (body))
(lemma rcl_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (z bool))
  (requires (=> z (rclosed c f mk x y)) (=> (not (ins mk y)) (<= (res c f x y) 0)))
  (ensures (=> z (rclosed c f mk x (+ y 1))))
  (body (if z (forall ((v int)) (call rcl_pt c f mk x y v)) (block))))
(lemma cl_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (closed c f mk x n) (=> (ins mk x) (rclosed c f mk x n)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (+ x 1))) (ins mk u)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (ins mk v))))
               (<= (res c f u v) 0)))
  (body))
(lemma cl_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (n int) (z bool))
  (requires (== y n) (=> z (closed c f mk x n)) (=> z (=> (ins mk x) (rclosed c f mk x y))))
  (ensures (=> z (closed c f mk (+ x 1) n)))
  (body
    (if z
      (block
        (assert (=> (ins mk x) (rclosed c f mk x n)))
        (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call cl_pt c f mk x n u v)))
      (block))))
(lemma sat_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flowok c f n) (closed c f mk n n))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (ins mk u)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (ins mk v))))
               (and (== (get_flow c u v) (get_flow f u v)) (== (get_flow f v u) 0))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (ins mk u)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (ins mk v))))
      (assert (<= (res c f u v) 0))
      (block))))

(lemma csum_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u m) (csum f u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call csum_link g f u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma c_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k 0) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call c_base g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma c_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (len g)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call c_out g f u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (tg g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma c1a (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (tg g u j) m))))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (tsum g f u k m)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call c1a g f u (- k 1) m) (block))))
(lemma c1b (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u)))) (== (tg g u i) m))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (+ (tsum g f u k m) (get_flow f u m))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (== (tg g u i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (if (== (- k 1) i)
      (block
        (forall ((j int)) (call tg_ne g u i j))
        (call c1a g f u (- k 1) m))
      (block
        (call tg_ne g u i (- k 1))
        (call c1b g f u (- k 1) m i)))))
(lemma c2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))) (rowz g f u))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rsum f u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call c2 g f u (- m 1))
        (if (istg g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- m 1))))
            (assert (== (tg g u i) (- m 1)))
            (call c1b g f u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1) i))
          (block
            (assert (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))
            (call c1a g f u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)))))
      (call c_base g f u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma row_conv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (rowz g f u))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rsum f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (csum f u (len g))))
  (body (call c_out g f u (len (idx g u))) (call c2 g f u (len g)) (call csum_link g f u (len g))))

(lemma pu_rs (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (pupd f f2 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rsum f2 u m) (+ (rsum f u m) (if (and (== u a) (< b m)) d 0))))
  (decreases m)

    (if (ins m1 v)

          (assert (== (idx p1 y) x))
          (assert (ins m1 x))
          (assert (== (idx o1 x) (idx o0 x)))

  (decreases m)

(lemma c_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))

(lemma c_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (len g)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)

    (block (call c_out g f u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (tg g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma c1a (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (tg g u j) m))))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (tsum g f u k m)))

(lemma c1b (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u)))) (== (tg g u i) m))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u k (+ m 1)) (+ (tsum g f u k m) (get_flow f u m))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (== (tg g u i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (if (== (- k 1) i)
      (block
        (forall ((j int)) (call tg_ne g u i j))
        (call c1a g f u (- k 1) m))
      (block
        (call tg_ne g u i (- k 1))
        (call c1b g f u (- k 1) m i)))))
(lemma c2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))) (rowz g f u))
  (ensures (== (tsum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rsum f u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call c2 g f u (- m 1))
        (if (istg g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- m 1))))
            (assert (== (tg g u i) (- m 1)))
            (call c1b g f u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1) i))
          (block
            (assert (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))
            (call c1a g f u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)))))
      (call c_base g f u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma row_conv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (rowz g f u))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rsum f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (csum f u (len g))))
  (body (call c_out g f u (len (idx g u))) (call c2 g f u (len g)) (call csum_link g f u (len g))))

(lemma pu_rs (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (m int))

(lemma fl_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int)
                     (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flowok c f n) (pupd f f2 a b d)
            (and (<= 0 (+ (get_flow f a b) d)) (<= (+ (get_flow f a b) d) (get_flow c a b))))

  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v))))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (+ (get_flow f u v) (if (and (== u a) (== v b)) d 0))))))
(lemma fl_upd (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (flowok c f n) (pupd f f2 a b d)
            (and (<= 0 (+ (get_flow f a b) d)) (<= (+ (get_flow f a b) d) (get_flow c a b))))

  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call fl_pt c f f2 a b d n u v))

(lemma split_rc (params (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int))

(lemma swap1 (params (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (a int) (b int))

  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))

  (decreases a)

  (requires (== (len mk) n) (ins mk s) (not (ins mk t)) (mcons f s t n))

(lemma mono_rt (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int) (z bool))
  (requires (>= m 0)

  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)

  (decreases a)

  (requires (>= m 0)

    (block (call it_range f mk (- a 1) n z)

    (block))))
(lemma rt_cap (params (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((v int)) (<= (get_flow f u v) 100000)))
  (ensures (<= (rt f mk u m) (* 100000 m)))
  (decreases m)

(lemma ot_single (params (f (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (s int) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (ins mk s) (forall ((u int)) (=> (ins mk u) (== u s))))
  (ensures (== (ot f mk a n) (if (< s a) (rt f mk s n) 0)))
  (decreases a)

(lemma vbound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (mcons f s t (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t) (<= (len g) 1000))
  (ensures (<= (- (rsum f s (len g)) (csum f s (len g))) 100000000))
  (body
    (ghost-let m1 (seq int) (seq-build (len g) (fn (j) (if (== j s) 1 0))))
    (assert (ins m1 s))
    (assert (not (ins m1 t)))
    (call cut f m1 s t (len g))
    (call mono_ot f c m1 (len g) (len g) false)
    (call it_range f m1 (len g) (len g) false)
    (call ot_single c m1 s (len g) (len g))
    (call rt_cap c m1 s (len g))))

  (body))
(lemma rc_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
    (and (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
         (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0) (exists ((x int)) (and (has_capacity g u v x) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) x)))))))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))
    (assert (=> (> (get_flow f u v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v))))))

  (requires (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f)
           (forall ((u int) (v int))
             (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call rc_pt g c f a b))))
(lemma cons_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (mcons f s t (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
               (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
      (block
        (call frow g c f u)
        (call row_conv g f u)
        (assert (== (csum f u (len g)) (rsum f u (len g)))))
      (block))))
(lemma cons_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (mcons f s t (len g)))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f s t))
  (body (forall ((u int)) (call cons_one g c f s t u))))
(lemma fin_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok g c) (flowok c f (len g)) (mcons f s t (len g)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (- (rsum f s (len g)) (csum f s (len g)))))
  (body
    (call resp_cap g c f)
    (call cons_ok g c f s t)
    (call frow g c f s)
    (call row_conv g f s)))

  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures (rowz g f u))
  (body (assert (respects_capacity g f))))
(lemma cons_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (csum f u (len g)) (rsum f u (len g))))
  (body (call rowz_valid g f s t u) (call row_conv g f u) (assert (is_conserved g f s t))))
(lemma cap_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (capok g c) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures (forall ((u int) (v int)) (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))))
  (body (assert (respects_capacity g f))))
(lemma opt_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (mk (seq int)) (f (seq (seq int)))
                       (s int) (t int) (fv int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capok g c) (== (len mk) (len g)) (ins mk s) (not (ins mk t))
            (== fv (ot c mk (len g) (len g))) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g f s) fv))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call cons_pt g f s t u))
    (assert (mcons f s t (len g)))
    (call rowz_valid g f s t s)
    (call row_conv g f s)
    (call cut f mk s t (len g))
    (call cap_le g c f s t)
    (call mono_ot f c mk (len g) (len g) false)
    (call it_range f mk (len g) (len g) false)))

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (ghost-let gg (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_view graph)
    (assert (== gg (field graph adj)))
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== n (len gg)))
    (assert (<= n 1000))
    (let-mut cm (vec (vec i64)) (vec-new))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (capok_upto gg cm u))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (assert (== deg (len (idx gg u))))
      (let-mut row (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j1) 0)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (rowok gg row u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
        (assert (and (== (get e 0) (tg gg u i)) (== (get e 1) (cp gg u i))))
        (call cap_entry gg u i)
        (ghost-let rw0 (seq int) row)
        (set-idx row (get e 0) (get e 1))
        (assert (upd1 rw0 row (tg gg u i) (cp gg u i)))
        (call rowok_step gg rw0 row u i)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (ghost-let cm0 (seq (seq int)) cm)
      (push cm row)
      (call cu_push gg cm0 cm row u)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call capok_intro gg cm)
    (let-mut fm (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j2) (seq-build n (fn (j3) 0)))))
    (assert (forall ((a int) (b int)) (== (get_flow fm a b) 0)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call z_sums fm w n))
    (let-mut val i64 0)
    (let-mut go bool true)
    (let-mut mk (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (let-mut par (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (ghost-let-mut ord (seq int) (seq-lit))
    (ghost-let-mut cnt int 0)
    (while go
      (invariant (capok gg cm))
      (invariant (flowok cm fm n))
      (invariant (mcons fm s t n))
      (invariant (== val (- (rsum fm s n) (csum fm s n))))
      (invariant (<= val 100000000))
      (invariant (=> (not go) (and (and (== (len mk) n) (ins mk s)) (and (not (ins mk t)) (closed cm fm mk n n)))))
      (decreases (+ (* 2 (- 100000000 val)) (if go 1 0)))
      (set mk (seq-build n (fn (j4) 0)))
      (set-idx mk s 1)
      (set par (seq-build n (fn (j5) 0)))
      (ghost-set ord (seq-build n (fn (j6) 0)))
      (ghost-set cnt 1)
      (call unm_nn mk n)
      (let-mut ch bool true)
      (while ch
        (invariant (spar mk par ord cnt s n))
        (invariant (sres cm fm mk par ord s cnt))
        (invariant (>= (unm mk n) 0))
        (invariant (=> (not ch) (closed cm fm mk n n)))
        (decreases (+ (* 2 (unm mk n)) (if ch 1 0)))
        (set ch false)
        (ghost-let u0 int (unm mk n))
        (let-mut x i64 0)
        (while (< x n)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (<= x n)))
          (invariant (spar mk par ord cnt s n))
          (invariant (sres cm fm mk par ord s cnt))
          (invariant (>= (unm mk n) 0))
          (invariant (=> (not ch) (and (== (unm mk n) u0) (closed cm fm mk x n))))
          (invariant (=> ch (< (unm mk n) u0)))
          (decreases (- n x))
          (if (== (idx mk x) 1)
            (block
              (let-mut y i64 0)
              (while (< y n)
                (invariant (and (<= 0 y) (<= y n)))
                (invariant (spar mk par ord cnt s n))
                (invariant (sres cm fm mk par ord s cnt))
                (invariant (>= (unm mk n) 0))
                (invariant (ins mk x))
                (invariant (=> (not ch) (and (== (unm mk n) u0) (and (closed cm fm mk x n) (rclosed cm fm mk x y)))))
                (invariant (=> ch (< (unm mk n) u0)))

  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (sumb g h x a (- b 1)) (if (mem x (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0)))))

(ghost-fn upd2 ((f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (get_flow f2 a b) (+ (get_flow f a b) d))
    (forall ((i int) (j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i n)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)))
      (or (and (== i a) (== j b)) (== (get_flow f2 i j) (get_flow f i j))))))))
(ghost-fn netf ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int)) int
  (body (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u))))
(ghost-fn walknet ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (cur int) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g))) (and (!= w cur) (!= w t))) (== (netf g f w) (netf g f0 w))))
    (and (=> (!= cur t) (and (== (netf g f cur) (+ (netf g f0 cur) 1)) (== (netf g f t) (- (netf g f0 t) 1))))

(ghost-fn nonint ((f (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (oc int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))

             (and (and (< x (len ord)) (< y (len ord))) (and (<= (idx ord x) oc) (<= (idx ord y) oc))))

(ghost-fn bq1 ((q (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q)))
      (and (and (<= 0 (idx q k)) (< (idx q k) n)) (and (< (idx q k) (len ord)) (== (idx ord (idx q k)) k)))))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (< v (len ord)) (!= (idx ord v) -1)))

  (body (forall ((v int))

        (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n)) (< (idx par v) (len ord)))

  (body (forall ((w int) (v int))

  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v i)) (and (< v (len ord)) (rs f c u v))) (!= (idx ord v) -1)))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma o_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (+ (outlt g h u m k) (outeq g h u m k)) (outlt g h u (+ m 1) k)))

(lemma o_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (i0 int) (k int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) m) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (outeq g h u m k) (if (< i0 k) (get_flow h u m) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call o_one g h u m i0 (- k 1))
           (assert (=> (!= (- k 1) i0) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m))))
    (block))))
(lemma o_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (== (get_flow h u m) 0))

  (decreases k)

(lemma o_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma o_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (outlt g h u (len g) k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call o_full g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma o_pick (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (or (== (get_flow h u m) 0)
                (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) m)))))
  (ensures (== (outeq g h u m (len (idx g u))) (get_flow h u m)))
  (body (if (== (get_flow h u m) 0)
    (call o_zero g h u m (len (idx g u)))
    (block
      (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) m)))
      (call o_one g h u m i0 (len (idx g u)))))))
(lemma o_conv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g)))
            (forall ((v int)) (or (== (get_flow h u v) 0)
              (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))))))
  (ensures (== (outlt g h u m (len (idx g u))) (rowsum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call o_conv g h u (- m 1))
           (call o_split g h u (- m 1) (len (idx g u)))
           (call o_pick g h u (- m 1)))
    (call o_base g h u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma vh (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (or (== (get_flow h u v) 0)
    (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow h u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
      (assert (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
      (obtain ((c1 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c1) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c1)))
      (obtain ((i1 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 (len (idx g u)))))
                              (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i1) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i1) 1) c1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma conv_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rowsum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call vh g h u v s t))
    (call o_full g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (call o_conv g h u (len g))))

(lemma l_row (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))

(lemma st1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfs g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len g))))

  (decreases a)

    (block (call st1 g h x (- a 1) s t)

           (call l_row h x (- a 1) (len g)))
    (block))))
(lemma st2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_conserved g h s t) (mem x s) (not (mem x t)) (!= s t)

  (ensures (== (sumt g h x a) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))

(lemma r1 (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int) (m int) (n int))

  (requires (bounded_by h c n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))

  (decreases a)

  (requires (is_cut f c x n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))

  (decreases a)

(lemma hb1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (capa g c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
    (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u v)) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v)))))
  (body (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
      (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) cc)))
      (assert (== (get_flow c u v) cc)))
    (block))))
(lemma hb (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (capa g c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)))
  (ensures (bounded_by h c (len g)))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call hb1 g h c s t u v))))
(lemma wd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfs g) (capa g c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (mem x s) (not (mem x t)) (!= s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) (ccap c x (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (call hb g h c s t)
    (call st1 g h x (len g) s t)
    (call st2 g h x (len g) s t)
    (call fub g h x (len g) (len g))
    (call s1 h c x (len g) (len g))))
(lemma maxflow (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfs g) (capa g c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (is_cut f c x (len g))
            (mem x s) (not (mem x t)) (!= s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call st1 g f x (len g) s t)
    (call st2 g f x (len g) s t)
    (call fub g f x (len g) (len g))
    (call s2 f c x (len g) (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (ccap c x (len g) (len g))))
    (forall ((o (seq (seq int)))) (call wd g o c x s t))))

  (body (forall ((w int) (v int)) (=> (and (and (<= u0 w) (< w n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (== (get_flow cm w v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn set2 ((m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (get_flow m1 a b) x)
    (forall ((i int) (j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i n)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)))
      (or (and (== i a) (== j b)) (== (get_flow m1 i j) (get_flow m0 i j))))))))
(ghost-fn rowsum ((h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rowsum h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
(ghost-fn outlt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g)))) 0
    (if (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
      (+ (outlt g h u m (- k 1)) (if (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m) (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) 0))
      (outlt g h u m (- k 1))))))
(ghost-fn outeq ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g)))) 0
    (if (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
      (+ (outeq g h u m (- k 1)) (if (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m) (get_flow h u m) 0))
      (outeq g h u m (- k 1))))))
(ghost-fn rowx ((h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rowx h x u (- m 1)) (if (mem x (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cro ((h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cro h x u (- m 1)) (if (and (mem x u) (not (mem x (- m 1)))) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cri ((h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cri h x u (- m 1)) (if (and (not (mem x u)) (mem x (- m 1))) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn suma ((h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (suma h x (- a 1) b) (rowx h x (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn sumb ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (sumb g h x a (- b 1)) (if (mem x (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
(ghost-fn tnode ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int)) int
  (body (if (mem x u) (- (total_flow_out g h u) (total_flow_in g h u)) 0)))
(ghost-fn sumt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (sumt g h x (- a 1)) (tnode g h x (- a 1))))))
(ghost-fn sumc ((h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (sumc h x (- a 1) n) (- (cro h x (- a 1) n) (cri h x (- a 1) n))))))
(ghost-fn ccap ((c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (ccap c x (- a 1) n) (cro c x (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn upd2 ((f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (get_flow f2 a b) (+ (get_flow f a b) d))
    (forall ((i int) (j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i n)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)))
      (or (and (== i a) (== j b)) (== (get_flow f2 i j) (get_flow f i j))))))))
(ghost-fn netf ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int)) int
  (body (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u))))
(ghost-fn walknet ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (cur int) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g))) (and (!= w cur) (!= w t))) (== (netf g f w) (netf g f0 w))))
    (and (=> (!= cur t) (and (== (netf g f cur) (+ (netf g f0 cur) 1)) (== (netf g f t) (- (netf g f0 t) 1))))
         (=> (== cur t) (== (netf g f t) (netf g f0 t)))))))
(ghost-fn nonint ((f (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (oc int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
             (and (and (< x (len ord)) (< y (len ord))) (and (<= (idx ord x) oc) (<= (idx ord y) oc))))
        (== (get_flow f x y) (get_flow f0 x y))))))
(ghost-fn bq1 ((q (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q)))
      (and (and (<= 0 (idx q k)) (< (idx q k) n)) (and (< (idx q k) (len ord)) (== (idx ord (idx q k)) k)))))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (< v (len ord)) (!= (idx ord v) -1)))
      (and (and (<= 0 (idx ord v)) (< (idx ord v) (len q))) (== (idx q (idx ord v)) v)))))))
(ghost-fn bq2 ((f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (< v (len ord)) (< v (len par)))) (and (!= (idx ord v) -1) (!= v s)))
        (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n)) (< (idx par v) (len ord)))
             (and (and (!= (idx ord (idx par v)) -1) (< (idx ord (idx par v)) (idx ord v))) (rs f c (idx par v) v)))))))
(ghost-fn bq3 ((f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (hd int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
             (and (and (< w (len ord)) (< v (len ord))) (and (and (!= (idx ord w) -1) (< (idx ord w) hd)) (rs f c w v))))
        (!= (idx ord v) -1)))))
(ghost-fn bq4 ((f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v i)) (and (< v (len ord)) (rs f c u v))) (!= (idx ord v) -1)))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma o_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (+ (outlt g h u m k) (outeq g h u m k)) (outlt g h u (+ m 1) k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call o_split g h u m (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma o_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (i0 int) (k int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) m) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (outeq g h u m k) (if (< i0 k) (get_flow h u m) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call o_one g h u m i0 (- k 1))
           (assert (=> (!= (- k 1) i0) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m))))
    (block))))
(lemma o_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (== (get_flow h u m) 0))
  (ensures (== (outeq g h u m k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call o_zero g h u m (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma o_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (outlt g h u 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call o_base g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma o_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (outlt g h u (len g) k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call o_full g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma o_pick (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (or (== (get_flow h u m) 0)
                (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) m)))))
  (ensures (== (outeq g h u m (len (idx g u))) (get_flow h u m)))
  (body (if (== (get_flow h u m) 0)
    (call o_zero g h u m (len (idx g u)))
    (block
      (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) m)))
      (call o_one g h u m i0 (len (idx g u)))))))
(lemma o_conv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g)))
            (forall ((v int)) (or (== (get_flow h u v) 0)
              (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))))))
  (ensures (== (outlt g h u m (len (idx g u))) (rowsum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call o_conv g h u (- m 1))
           (call o_split g h u (- m 1) (len (idx g u)))
           (call o_pick g h u (- m 1)))
    (call o_base g h u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma vh (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (or (== (get_flow h u v) 0)
    (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow h u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
      (assert (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
      (obtain ((c1 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c1) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c1)))
      (obtain ((i1 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 (len (idx g u)))))
                              (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i1) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i1) 1) c1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma conv_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfs g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rowsum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call vh g h u v s t))
    (call o_full g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (call o_conv g h u (len g))))

(lemma l_row (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (if (mem x u) (rowsum h u m) 0) (- (+ (cro h x u m) (rowx h x u m)) (cri h x u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call l_row h x u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma fub1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (sumb g h x (+ a 1) b) (+ (sumb g h x a b) (rowx h x a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call fub1 g h x a (- b 1))
           (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) (+ a 1))
                       (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma fub0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (b int))
  (ensures (== (sumb g h x 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call fub0 g h x (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma fub (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (suma h x a b) (sumb g h x a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call fub g h x (- a 1) b) (call fub1 g h x (- a 1) b))
    (call fub0 g h x b))))
(lemma st1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfs g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len g))))
  (ensures (== (sumt g h x a) (- (+ (sumc h x a (len g)) (suma h x a (len g))) (sumb g h x (len g) a))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call st1 g h x (- a 1) s t)
           (call conv_valid g h (- a 1) s t)
           (call l_row h x (- a 1) (len g)))
    (block))))
(lemma st2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_conserved g h s t) (mem x s) (not (mem x t)) (!= s t)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len g))))
  (ensures (== (sumt g h x a) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call st2 g h x (- a 1) s t) (block))))
(lemma r1 (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int) (m int) (n int))
  (requires (bounded_by h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (<= (cro h x u m) (cro c x u m)) (>= (cri h x u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call r1 h c x u (- m 1) n) (block))))
(lemma s1 (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (bounded_by h c n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (sumc h x a n) (ccap c x a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (block (call s1 h c x (- a 1) n) (call r1 h c x (- a 1) n n)) (block))))
(lemma r2 (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (u int) (m int) (n int))
  (requires (is_cut f c x n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (== (cro f x u m) (cro c x u m)) (== (cri f x u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call r2 f c x u (- m 1) n) (block))))
(lemma s2 (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (is_cut f c x n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (== (sumc f x a n) (ccap c x a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (block (call s2 f c x (- a 1) n) (call r2 f c x (- a 1) n n)) (block))))
(lemma hb1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (capa g c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
    (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u v)) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v)))))
  (body (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
      (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) cc)))
      (assert (== (get_flow c u v) cc)))
    (block))))
(lemma hb (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (capa g c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)))
  (ensures (bounded_by h c (len g)))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call hb1 g h c s t u v))))
(lemma wd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfs g) (capa g c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (mem x s) (not (mem x t)) (!= s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) (ccap c x (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (call hb g h c s t)
    (call st1 g h x (len g) s t)
    (call st2 g h x (len g) s t)
    (call fub g h x (len g) (len g))
    (call s1 h c x (len g) (len g))))
(lemma maxflow (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfs g) (capa g c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (is_cut f c x (len g))
            (mem x s) (not (mem x t)) (!= s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call st1 g f x (len g) s t)
    (call st2 g f x (len g) s t)
    (call fub g f x (len g) (len g))
    (call s2 f c x (len g) (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (ccap c x (len g) (len g))))
    (forall ((o (seq (seq int)))) (call wd g o c x s t))))

(lemma z_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (allz f))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call z_out g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma z_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (allz f))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call z_in g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma z_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (allz f))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) 0) (== (total_flow_in g f u) 0))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (call z_out g f u (len (idx g u))) (block))
    (call z_in g f u (len g))))
(lemma z_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (allz f))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) 0))
  (body (call z_net g f s) (forall ((u int)) (call z_net g f u))))

(lemma fl_nn1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (sq f (len g)) (bounded_by f c (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
    (block
      (assert (and (== (len f) (len g)) (== (len (idx f u)) (len g))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma fl_rc1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (sq f (len g)) (bounded_by f c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
    (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0) (exists ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) cc))))))
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
    (if (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (== (len f) (len g)) (== (len (idx f u)) (len g))))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))
        (assert (> (get_flow c u v) 0))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
        (assert (exists ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) cc)))))
      (block))
    (block))))
(lemma fl_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (sq f (len g)) (bounded_by f c (len g)) (capb g c (len g)) (is_conserved g f s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))

  (ensures (and (>= (idx st w) -1) (=> (>= (idx st w) 0) (and (< (idx st w) (len q)) (== (idx q (idx st w)) w)))))
  (body (if (== w v)
    (block (assert (== (idx st w) (len q0))) (assert (== (idx q (len q0)) v)))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx st w) (idx st0 w)))
      (assert (>= (idx st0 w) -1))
      (if (>= (idx st0 w) 0)
        (block
          (assert (and (< (idx st0 w) (len q0)) (== (idx q0 (idx st0 w)) w)))
          (assert (== (idx q (idx st0 w)) (idx q0 (idx st0 w)))))
        (block))))))
(lemma rq (params (st0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (st (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (qinv st0 q0) (upd st0 st v (len q0)) (== (idx st0 v) -1) (appended q0 q v))
  (ensures (qinv st q))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call rq1k st0 q0 st q v k))
    (forall ((w int)) (call rq2w st0 q0 st q v w))))
(lemma rtw (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (st0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int)) (st (seq int)) (par (seq int))
                   (s int) (u int) (v int) (x int) (w int))
  (requires (tree_ok cm fl st0 par0 s) (== (len par0) (len st0)) (upd st0 st v x) (upd par0 par v u) (== (idx st0 v) -1)
            (mem st0 u) (< (idx st0 u) x) (res cm fl u v) (mem st w) (!= w s))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx par w)) (< (idx par w) (len st)))
                (and (and (>= (idx st (idx par w)) 0) (< (idx st (idx par w)) (idx st w)))
                     (res cm fl (idx par w) w))))
  (body (if (== w v)
    (block
      (assert (== (idx par w) u))
      (assert (!= u v))
      (assert (== (idx st u) (idx st0 u)))
      (assert (== (idx st w) x)))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx st w) (idx st0 w)))
      (assert (mem st0 w))
      (assert (== (idx par w) (idx par0 w)))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (idx par0 w)) (< (idx par0 w) (len st0)))
                   (and (and (>= (idx st0 (idx par0 w)) 0) (< (idx st0 (idx par0 w)) (idx st0 w)))
                        (res cm fl (idx par0 w) w))))
      (assert (!= (idx par0 w) v))
      (assert (== (idx st (idx par0 w)) (idx st0 (idx par0 w))))))))
(lemma rt_all (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (st0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int)) (st (seq int)) (par (seq int))
                      (s int) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (tree_ok cm fl st0 par0 s) (mem st0 s) (== (len par0) (len st0)) (upd st0 st v x) (upd par0 par v u)
            (== (idx st0 v) -1) (mem st0 u) (< (idx st0 u) x) (res cm fl u v))
  (ensures (mem st s) (tree_ok cm fl st par s))
  (body
    (assert (!= s v))
    (assert (== (idx st s) (idx st0 s)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call rtw cm fl st0 par0 st par s u v x w))))
(lemma rdonek (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (st0 (seq int)) (st (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (q (seq int))
                      (head int) (v int) (x int) (k int) (b int))
  (requires (done cm fl st0 q0 head) (upd st0 st v x) (>= x 0) (appended q0 q v) (<= head (len q0))
            (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len q))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len st))))
            (res cm fl (idx q k) b))
  (ensures (>= (idx st b) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx q k) (idx q0 k)))
    (if (== b v)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx st b) (idx st0 b)))
        (assert (=> (res cm fl (idx q0 k) b) (>= (idx st0 b) 0)))))))
(lemma rdone (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (st0 (seq int)) (st (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (q (seq int))
                     (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (done cm fl st0 q0 head) (upd st0 st v x) (>= x 0) (appended q0 q v) (<= head (len q0)))
  (ensures (done cm fl st q head))
  (body (forall ((k int) (b int)) (call rdonek cm fl st0 st q0 q head v x k b))))
(lemma rpartb (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (st0 (seq int)) (st (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int) (b int))
  (requires (part cm fl st0 u v) (upd st0 st v x) (>= x 0)
            (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (+ v 1))) (< b (len st))) (res cm fl u b))
  (ensures (>= (idx st b) 0))
  (body (if (== b v)
    (assert (== (idx st b) x))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx st b) (idx st0 b)))
      (assert (=> (res cm fl u b) (>= (idx st0 b) 0)))))))
(lemma rpart (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (st0 (seq int)) (st (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (part cm fl st0 u v) (upd st0 st v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (part cm fl st u (+ v 1)))
  (body (forall ((b int)) (call rpartb cm fl st0 st u v x b))))
(lemma rseenb (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (b int))
  (requires (part cm fl st u v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len st))) (=> (res cm fl u v) (>= (idx st v) 0))
            (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (+ v 1))) (< b (len st))) (res cm fl u b))
  (ensures (>= (idx st b) 0))
  (body (if (== b v) (block) (assert (=> (res cm fl u b) (>= (idx st b) 0))))))
(lemma rseen (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (part cm fl st u v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len st))) (=> (res cm fl u v) (>= (idx st v) 0)))
  (ensures (part cm fl st u (+ v 1)))
  (body (forall ((b int)) (call rseenb cm fl st u v b))))

(lemma es_miss (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- m 1)))))
  (ensures (== (es g f u k m) (es g f u k (- m 1))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call es_miss g f u (- k 1) m) (block))))
(lemma es_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int) (j int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- m 1)))
  (ensures (== (es g f u k m) (+ (es g f u k (- m 1)) (get_flow f u (- m 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (== j (- k 1))
    (call es_miss g f u (- k 1) m)
    (call es_hit g f u (- k 1) m j))))
(lemma es_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (es g f u k 0) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call es_zero g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma rs_es (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (supp g f u) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rs f u m) (es g f u (len (idx g u)) m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call rs_es g f u (- m 1))
      (if (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- m 1))))
        (block
          (obtain ((jj int)) (and (and (<= 0 jj) (< jj (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) jj) 0) (- m 1))))
          (call es_hit g f u (len (idx g u)) m jj))
        (block
          (assert (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))
          (call es_miss g f u (len (idx g u)) m))))
    (call es_zero g f u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma es_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (es g f u k (len g)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call es_full g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma in_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (cs f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call in_eq g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma flows_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (supp g f u))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rs f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (cs f u (len g))))
  (body
    (call rs_es g f u (len g))
    (call es_full g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_eq g f u (len g))))
(lemma supp1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))))
      (assert (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
      (assert (respects_capacity g f))
      (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) cc)))
      (obtain ((ii int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 ii) (< ii (len (idx g u)))))
                              (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) ii) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) ii) 1) cc)))))
    (block))))
(lemma supp2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (> (get_flow cm u v) 0))
      (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cm u v)))
      (obtain ((ii int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 ii) (< ii (len (idx g u)))))
                              (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) ii) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) ii) 1) (get_flow cm u v))))))
    (block))))
(lemma cons1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rs f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (cs f u (len g)))
           (=> (and (!= u s) (!= u t)) (== (cs f u (len g)) (rs f u (len g)))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call supp1 g f s t u v))
    (assert (supp g f u))
    (call flows_eq g f u)
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (assert (=> (and (!= u s) (!= u t)) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u))))))
(lemma cons_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (cons_ok f s t (len g)) (== (flow_val g f s) (- (rs f s (len g)) (cs f s (len g)))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call cons1 g f s t u))
    (call cons1 g f s t s)))
(lemma ours1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f) (cons_ok f s t (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rs f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (cs f u (len g)))
           (=> (and (!= u s) (!= u t)) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call supp2 g cm f u v))
    (assert (supp g f u))
    (call flows_eq g f u)))
(lemma cellc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f) (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
            (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow cm u v)))
    (assert (> (get_flow cm u v) 0))
    (assert (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cm u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cm u v))))))
(lemma celln (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (bnd cm f) (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)))))
(lemma resp_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call cellc g cm f u v))))
(lemma nn_ok (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (bnd cm f))
  (ensures (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call celln cm f u v))))
(lemma conserved_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f) (cons_ok f s t (len g)))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f s t))
  (body (forall ((w int)) (call ours1 g cm f s t w))))
(lemma ours_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f) (cons_ok f s t (len g)))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call resp_ok g cm f)
    (call nn_ok cm f)
    (call conserved_ok g cm f s t)))

(lemma cw0 (params (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (m int))
  (ensures (== (cw f st 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call cw0 f st (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma sw1 (params (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 1))
  (ensures (== (cw f st k m) (+ (cw f st (- k 1) m) (rss f st (- k 1) m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call sw1 f st k (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma sw (params (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (cw f st k m) (rw f st k m)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (block (call sw f st (- k 1) m) (call sw1 f st k m)) (call cw0 f st m))))
(lemma rt_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (rt f st a m) (- (if (mem st a) (rs f a m) 0) (rss f st a m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call rt_eq f st a (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma tt_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (n int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (tt f st n k) (- (srs f st n k) (rw f st k n))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (block (call tt_eq f st n (- k 1)) (call rt_eq f st (- k 1) n)) (block))))
(lemma pot_val (params (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (m int))
  (requires (cons_ok f s t n) (mem st s) (not (mem st t)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (== (- (srs f st n m) (cw f st n m)) (if (< s m) (- (rs f s n) (cs f s n)) 0)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call pot_val f st s t n (- m 1))
      (assert (=> (and (mem st (- m 1)) (!= (- m 1) s)) (== (cs f (- m 1) n) (rs f (- m 1) n)))))
    (block))))
(lemma val_tt (params (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (cons_ok f s t n) (mem st s) (not (mem st t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (- (rs f s n) (cs f s n)) (tt f st n n)))
  (body (call pot_val f st s t n n) (call sw f st n n) (call tt_eq f st n n)))
(lemma tm_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (fo (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                     (st (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g fo s t) (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f) (closed_res cm f st)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len st))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len st))))
  (ensures (<= (tm fo st a b) (tm f st a b)))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow fo a b) 0))
    (if (and (mem st a) (not (mem st b)))
      (block
        (assert (not (res cm f a b)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (get_flow cm a b)))
        (if (> (get_flow fo a b) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len fo))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx fo a))))))
            (assert (respects_capacity g fo))
            (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g a b cc) (<= (idx (idx fo a) b) cc)))
            (assert (== (get_flow cm a b) cc)))
          (block)))
      (if (and (not (mem st a)) (mem st b))
        (assert (not (res cm f b a)))
        (block)))))
(lemma rt_mono (params (fo (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (n int) (m int))
  (requires (forall ((b int)) (=> (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (<= (tm fo st a b) (tm f st a b)))) (<= m n))
  (ensures (<= (rt fo st a m) (rt f st a m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call rt_mono fo f st a n (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma tt_mono (params (fo (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((a int) (b int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
                                          (<= (tm fo st a b) (tm f st a b))))
            (<= k n))
  (ensures (<= (tt fo st n k) (tt f st n k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (block (call tt_mono fo f st n (- k 1)) (call rt_mono fo f st (- k 1) n n)) (block))))
(lemma beats (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int))
                     (s int) (t int) (fo (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f) (is_valid_flow g f s t)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
            (== (len st) (len g)) (mem st s) (not (mem st t)) (closed_res cm f st)
            (is_valid_flow g fo s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g fo s)))
  (body
    (call cons_all g f s t)
    (call cons_all g fo s t)
    (call val_tt f st s t (len g))
    (call val_tt fo st s t (len g))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call tm_le g cm fo f st s t a b))
    (call tt_mono fo f st (len g) (len g))))
(lemma final_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int))
                        (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g cm) (bnd cm f) (cons_ok f s t (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
            (== (len st) (len g)) (mem st s) (not (mem st t)) (closed_res cm f st))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (- (rs f s (len g)) (cs f s (len g)))))
  (body
    (call ours_valid g cm f s t)
    (call cons_all g f s t)
    (forall ((fo (seq (seq int)))) (call beats g cm f st s t fo))))

(spec build_cap
  (params (gr capacity_graph))
  (returns (cm (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (wf (view gr)) (capacities_bounded (view gr)))
  (ensures (sq cm (len (view gr))) (cap_ok (view gr) cm))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_cap
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view gr))
    (assert (wf g))
    (assert (capacities_bounded g))
    (let n i64 (len (field gr adj)))
    (let-mut cm (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (a) (seq-build n (fn (b) 0)))))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== n (len g)))
      (invariant (sq cm n))
      (invariant (rows_ok g cm u))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field gr adj) u)))
      (ghost-let c0 (seq (seq int)) cm)
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
