    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step es p k))
    (assert (== (len (rev p)) (len p)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es (rev p)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (- (len (rev p)) 1)) x))))
(lemma cat_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (path_follows_edges es r) (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len r) 0))
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx r 0))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (cat p r)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (cat p r) k) (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (cat p r)) (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1)))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let k3 int (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx r k3) (idx r (+ k3 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) k) (idx r k3)))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1)) (idx r (+ k3 1))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) y) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es r)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_step es p r k))
    (assert (== (len (cat p r)) (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es (cat p r)))
    (assert (== (idx (cat p r) 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (- (len (cat p r)) 1)) z))))

(lemma edge_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t x y))
  (body
    (call edge_pick es x y)
    (obtain ((ee int)) (pair_at es ee x y))
    (assert (== (idx t ee) (idx es ee)))
    (assert (pair_at t ee x y))))
(lemma path_mono_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_mono es t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected t x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call path_mono_step es t p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t p))))

(lemma lift1 (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (edge_in_set t x y) (not (pair_at t j x y)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t3 x y))
  (body
    (call edge_pick t x y)
    (obtain ((ee int)) (pair_at t ee x y))
    (if (== ee k)
      (block (assert (!= j k)) (assert (== (idx t3 j) (idx t k))) (assert (pair_at t3 j x y)))
      (block (assert (== (idx t3 ee) (idx t ee))) (assert (pair_at t3 ee x y))))))
(lemma reroute (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (path_follows_edges t p) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
            (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 (idx p 0) (idx p i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (call conn_refl t3 (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call reroute t t3 j k p (- i 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (if (pair_at t j (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))
          (if (== (get (idx t j) 0) (idx p (- i 1)))
            (assert (edges_connected t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
            (call conn_sym t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
          (block
            (call lift1 t t3 j k (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))
            (call edge_conn t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))))
        (assert (edges_connected t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (call conn_trans t3 (idx p 0) (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))))))
(lemma suffix (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (ins (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (path_follows_edges t q) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m i)) (< i (len q)))
            (out_after ins q m)
            (or (in_s ins (get (idx t j) 0)) (in_s ins (get (idx t j) 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx q i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i (+ m 1))
      (call conn_refl t3 (idx q i))
      (block
        (call suffix t t3 j k ins q m (- i 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i)))
        (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q (- i 1)))))
        (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q i))))
        (assert (not (pair_at t j (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))))
        (call lift1 t t3 j k (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))
        (call edge_conn t3 (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))
        (call conn_trans t3 (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))))))
(lemma last_cross (params (ins (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (> (len q) 0) (in_s ins (idx q 0)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))) (out_after ins q (- i 1)))
  (ensures (exists ((m int)) (cross_at ins q m)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q i))))
    (assert (>= i 1))
    (if (in_s ins (idx q (- i 1)))
      (assert (cross_at ins q (- i 1)))
      (block
        (assert (out_after ins q (- i 2)))
        (call last_cross ins q (- i 1))))))

(lemma tw_upd (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd_t s i x)) (+ (- (total_weight s) (get (idx s i) 2)) (get x 2))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd_t s i x)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd_t s i x)) (+ (get (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd_t s i x) 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) x))
        (assert (== (drop (upd_t s i x) 1) (drop s 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) (idx s 0)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd_t s i x) 1) (upd_t (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)))
        (call tw_upd (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- i 1)) (idx s i)))))))
(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g s) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (upd_t s i x)))
  (body))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (rel t t3 j k) (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t u v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (call reroute t t3 j k p (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma exchange
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2))
    (is_spanning_tree g t)
    (prefix_of es t))
  (ensures (exists ((t4 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t4 t)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (edges_connected t a b))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t q)))
    (assert (out_after ins q (- (len q) 2)))
    (call last_cross ins q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((m int)) (cross_at ins q m))
    (ghost-let fm int (idx q m))
    (ghost-let fm1 int (idx q (+ m 1)))
    (assert (in_s ins fm))
    (assert (not (in_s ins fm1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set t fm fm1))
    (call edge_pick t fm fm1)
    (obtain ((j int)) (pair_at t j fm fm1))
    (ghost-let k int (len es))
    (if (< j k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t j) (idx es j)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx es j) 0)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx es j) 1)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (and (<= k j) (< j (len t))))
    (ghost-let tk (tuple int int int) (idx t k))
    (assert (has_edge g (get tk 0) (get tk 1) (get tk 2)))
    (ghost-let t1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd_t t j tk))
    (ghost-let t3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd_t t1 k e))
    (assert (== (len t1) (len t)))
    (assert (== (len t3) (len t)))
    (call tw_upd t j tk)
    (call tw_upd t1 k e)
    (call valid_upd g t j tk)
    (call valid_upd g t1 k e)
    (assert (== (idx t1 k) tk))
    (assert (== (idx t3 k) e))
    (assert (rel t t3 j k))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1) (get (idx t j) 2)))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx t j) 0)) (< (get (idx t j) 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g (get (idx t j) 0))))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t j) 0)) i0) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t j) 0)) i0) 1) (get (idx t j) 2)))))
    (assert (crosses g ins (get (idx t j) 0) i0))
    (assert (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get (idx t j) 2)))
    (assert (<= (total_weight t3) (total_weight t)))
    (assert (== (len t3) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (prefix_of (concat es (seq-lit e)) t3))
    (assert (prefix_of es t3))
    (assert (edges_connected es start fm))
    (assert (edges_connected es start a))
    (call conn_mono es t3 start fm)
    (call conn_mono es t3 start a)
    (assert (pair_at t3 k a b))
    (assert (edge_in_set t3 a b))
    (call edge_conn t3 a b)
    (call suffix t t3 j k ins q m (- (len q) 1))
    (call conn_sym t3 start fm)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm start a)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm a b)
    (call conn_sym t3 fm1 b)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm b fm1)
    (if (== (get (idx t j) 0) fm)
      (assert (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
      (call conn_sym t3 fm fm1))
    (assert (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_one g t t3 j k u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g t3))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t3))
    (assert (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t3 t))))
(lemma extend_one
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g es)
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
  (ensures (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g t)
      (block
        (assert (extendable g es))
        (assert (ext_at g es t))
        (obtain ((t2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g es t2 t))
        (assert (is_spanning_tree g t2))
        (assert (prefix_of es t2))
        (call exchange g ins start es e a b t2)
        (obtain ((t5 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t5 t2))
        (assert (<= (total_weight t2) (total_weight t)))
        (assert (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t5 t))
        (assert (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t)))
      (assert (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t)))))
(lemma extend_inv
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (extendable g es)
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
  (ensures (extendable g (concat es (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((t (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call extend_one g ins start es e a b t))))
(lemma ext_init_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len es) 0))
  (ensures (ext_at g es t))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g t)
      (block (assert (prefix_of es t)) (assert (better g es t t)) (assert (ext_at g es t)))
      (assert (ext_at g es t)))))
(lemma ext_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len es) 0))
  (ensures (extendable g es))
  (body (forall ((t (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_init_one g es t))))

(lemma in_mono (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (upd_in i0 i1 b) (in_s i0 x))
  (ensures (in_s i1 x))
  (body))
(lemma inside_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (inside es i0) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0)))))
  (ensures (inside (concat es (seq-lit e)) i1))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call in_mono i0 i1 b x))
    (assert (in_s i1 a))
    (assert (in_s i1 b))))
(lemma conn_push_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (start int) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (conn_s es i0 start) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
            (in_s i1 x))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit e)) start x))
  (body
    (ghost-let es1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es (seq-lit e)))
    (assert (prefix_of es es1))
    (if (in_s i0 x)
      (block (assert (edges_connected es start x)) (call conn_mono es es1 start x))
      (block
        (assert (== x b))
        (assert (edges_connected es start a))
        (call conn_mono es es1 start a)
        (assert (pair_at es1 (len es) a b))
        (assert (edge_in_set es1 a b))
        (call edge_conn es1 a b)
        (call conn_trans es1 start a b)))))
(lemma conn_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (start int) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (conn_s es i0 start) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0)))))
  (ensures (conn_s (concat es (seq-lit e)) i1 start))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call conn_push_one es i0 i1 start e a b x))))
(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat es (seq-lit e))))
  (body))
(lemma conn_init (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)))
  (requires (== (len es) 0) (forall ((y int)) (=> (in_s ins y) (== y 0))))
  (ensures (conn_s es ins 0))
  (body (call conn_refl es 0)))

(lemma all_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (no_cross g ins) (in_s ins 0) (== (len ins) (len g)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
  (ensures (in_s ins x))
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (if (in_s ins x)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (out_after ins p (- (len p) 2)))
        (call last_cross ins p (- (len p) 1))
        (obtain ((m int)) (cross_at ins p m))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g (idx p m))))))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p m)) i0) 0) (idx p (+ m 1)))))
        (assert (crosses g ins (idx p m) i0))
        (assert false)))))
(lemma span_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (conn_s es ins 0) (all_in_s ins) (== (len ins) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (assert (in_s ins u))
    (assert (in_s ins v))
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 u))
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 v))
    (call conn_sym es 0 u)
    (call conn_trans es u 0 v)))
(lemma min_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g es) (== (len es) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g o))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight es) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (assert (extendable g es))
    (assert (ext_at g es o))
    (obtain ((t2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g es t2 o))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t2))
    (assert (== (len t2) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (prefix_of es t2))
    (assert (== t2 es))))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (== (size graph) n))
    (assert (nbr_ok g))
    (let-mut ins (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j0) 0)))
    (set-idx ins 0 1)
    (let-mut edges (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (assert (forall ((x0 int)) (=> (in_s ins x0) (== x0 0))))
    (call conn_init edges ins)
    (call ext_init g edges)
    (let-mut done bool false)
    (while (not done)
      (invariant (== (len ins) n))
      (invariant (in_s ins 0))
      (invariant (== (+ (len edges) (occurrences ins 0)) (- n 1)))
      (invariant (>= (occurrences ins 0) 0))
      (invariant (are_valid_edges g edges))
      (invariant (conn_s edges ins 0))
      (invariant (inside edges ins))
      (invariant (extendable g edges))
      (invariant (=> done (all_in_s ins)))
      (decreases (+ (occurrences ins 0) (if done 0 1)))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut bu i64 0)
      (let-mut bi i64 0)
      (let-mut bw i64 0)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (seen_min g ins u 0 found bw))
        (invariant (=> found (best_ok g ins bu bi bw)))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
        (assert (== deg (len (idx g u))))

(lemma conn_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected t x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call path_mono_step es t p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t p))))

(lemma lift1 (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (edge_in_set t x y) (not (pair_at t j x y)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t3 x y))
  (body
    (call edge_pick t x y)
    (obtain ((ee int)) (pair_at t ee x y))
    (if (== ee k)
      (block (assert (!= j k)) (assert (== (idx t3 j) (idx t k))) (assert (pair_at t3 j x y)))
      (block (assert (== (idx t3 ee) (idx t ee))) (assert (pair_at t3 ee x y))))))
(lemma reroute (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (path_follows_edges t p) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
            (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 (idx p 0) (idx p i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (call conn_refl t3 (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call reroute t t3 j k p (- i 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (if (pair_at t j (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))
          (if (== (get (idx t j) 0) (idx p (- i 1)))
            (assert (edges_connected t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
            (call conn_sym t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
          (block
            (call lift1 t t3 j k (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))
            (call edge_conn t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))))
        (assert (edges_connected t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (call conn_trans t3 (idx p 0) (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))))))
(lemma suffix (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (ins (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (path_follows_edges t q) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m i)) (< i (len q)))
            (out_after ins q m)
            (or (in_s ins (get (idx t j) 0)) (in_s ins (get (idx t j) 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx q i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i (+ m 1))
      (call conn_refl t3 (idx q i))
      (block
        (call suffix t t3 j k ins q m (- i 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i)))
        (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q (- i 1)))))
        (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q i))))
        (assert (not (pair_at t j (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))))
        (call lift1 t t3 j k (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))
        (call edge_conn t3 (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))
        (call conn_trans t3 (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))))))
(lemma last_cross (params (ins (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (> (len q) 0) (in_s ins (idx q 0)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))) (out_after ins q (- i 1)))
  (ensures (exists ((m int)) (cross_at ins q m)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q i))))
    (assert (>= i 1))
    (if (in_s ins (idx q (- i 1)))
      (assert (cross_at ins q (- i 1)))
      (block
        (assert (out_after ins q (- i 2)))
        (call last_cross ins q (- i 1))))))

(lemma tw_upd (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd_t s i x)) (+ (- (total_weight s) (get (idx s i) 2)) (get x 2))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd_t s i x)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd_t s i x)) (+ (get (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd_t s i x) 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) x))
        (assert (== (drop (upd_t s i x) 1) (drop s 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) (idx s 0)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd_t s i x) 1) (upd_t (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)))
        (call tw_upd (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- i 1)) (idx s i)))))))
(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g s) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (upd_t s i x)))
  (body))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (rel t t3 j k) (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t u v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (call reroute t t3 j k p (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma prefix_rel (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (rel t t3 j k) (== k (len es)) (<= k j))

(lemma prefix_push_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))

            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ (len es) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx t3 i) (idx (concat es (seq-lit e)) i)))
  (body
    (if (< i (len es))
      (assert (== (idx t3 i) (idx es i)))
      (assert (== i (len es))))))
(lemma prefix_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (prefix_of es t3) (< (len es) (len t3)) (== (idx t3 (len es)) e))
  (ensures (prefix_of (concat es (seq-lit e)) t3))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat es (seq-lit e))) (+ (len es) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_push_at es e t3 i))))

(lemma exchange
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2))
    (is_spanning_tree g t)
    (prefix_of es t))
  (ensures (exists ((t4 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t4 t)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (edges_connected t a b))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t q)))
    (assert (out_after ins q (- (len q) 2)))
    (call last_cross ins q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((m int)) (cross_at ins q m))
    (ghost-let fm int (idx q m))
    (ghost-let fm1 int (idx q (+ m 1)))
    (assert (in_s ins fm))
    (assert (not (in_s ins fm1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set t fm fm1))
    (call edge_pick t fm fm1)
    (obtain ((j int)) (pair_at t j fm fm1))
    (ghost-let k int (len es))
    (if (< j k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t j) (idx es j)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx es j) 0)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx es j) 1)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (and (<= k j) (< j (len t))))
    (ghost-let tk (tuple int int int) (idx t k))
    (assert (has_edge g (get tk 0) (get tk 1) (get tk 2)))
    (ghost-let t1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd_t t j tk))
    (ghost-let t3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd_t t1 k e))
    (assert (== (len t1) (len t)))
    (assert (== (len t3) (len t)))
    (call tw_upd t j tk)
    (call tw_upd t1 k e)
    (call valid_upd g t j tk)
    (call valid_upd g t1 k e)
    (assert (== (idx t1 k) tk))
    (assert (== (idx t3 k) e))
    (assert (rel t t3 j k))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1) (get (idx t j) 2)))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx t j) 0)) (< (get (idx t j) 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g (get (idx t j) 0))))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t j) 0)) i0) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t j) 0)) i0) 1) (get (idx t j) 2)))))
    (assert (crosses g ins (get (idx t j) 0) i0))
    (assert (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get (idx t j) 2)))
    (assert (<= (total_weight t3) (total_weight t)))
    (assert (== (len t3) (- (len g) 1)))
    (call prefix_rel es t t3 j k)
    (call prefix_push es e t3)
    (assert (prefix_of es t3))
    (assert (edges_connected es start fm))
    (assert (edges_connected es start a))
    (call conn_mono es t3 start fm)
    (call conn_mono es t3 start a)
    (assert (pair_at t3 k a b))
    (assert (edge_in_set t3 a b))
    (call edge_conn t3 a b)
    (call suffix t t3 j k ins q m (- (len q) 1))
    (call conn_sym t3 start fm)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm start a)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm a b)
    (call conn_sym t3 fm1 b)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm b fm1)
    (if (== (get (idx t j) 0) fm)
      (assert (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
      (call conn_sym t3 fm fm1))
    (assert (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_one g t t3 j k u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g t3))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t3))
    (assert (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t3 t))))
(lemma extend_one
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g es)
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
  (ensures (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g t)
      (block
        (assert (extendable g es))
        (assert (ext_at g es t))
        (obtain ((t2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g es t2 t))
        (assert (is_spanning_tree g t2))
        (assert (prefix_of es t2))
        (call exchange g ins start es e a b t2)
        (obtain ((t5 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t5 t2))
        (assert (<= (total_weight t2) (total_weight t)))
        (assert (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t5 t))
        (assert (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t)))
      (assert (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t)))))
(lemma extend_inv
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (extendable g es)
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
  (ensures (extendable g (concat es (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((t (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call extend_one g ins start es e a b t))))
(lemma ext_init_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len es) 0))
  (ensures (ext_at g es t))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g t)
      (block (assert (prefix_of es t)) (assert (better g es t t)) (assert (ext_at g es t)))
      (assert (ext_at g es t)))))
(lemma ext_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len es) 0))
  (ensures (extendable g es))
  (body (forall ((t (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_init_one g es t))))

(lemma in_mono (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (upd_in i0 i1 b) (in_s i0 x))
  (ensures (in_s i1 x))
  (body))
(lemma inside_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (inside es i0) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0)))))
  (ensures (inside (concat es (seq-lit e)) i1))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call in_mono i0 i1 b x))
    (assert (in_s i1 a))
    (assert (in_s i1 b))))
(lemma conn_push_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (start int) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (conn_s es i0 start) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
            (in_s i1 x))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit e)) start x))
  (body
    (ghost-let es1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es (seq-lit e)))
    (assert (prefix_of es es1))
    (if (in_s i0 x)
      (block (assert (edges_connected es start x)) (call conn_mono es es1 start x))
      (block
        (assert (== x b))
        (assert (edges_connected es start a))
        (call conn_mono es es1 start a)
        (assert (pair_at es1 (len es) a b))
        (assert (edge_in_set es1 a b))
        (call edge_conn es1 a b)
        (call conn_trans es1 start a b)))))
(lemma conn_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (start int) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (conn_s es i0 start) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0)))))
  (ensures (conn_s (concat es (seq-lit e)) i1 start))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call conn_push_one es i0 i1 start e a b x))))
(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat es (seq-lit e))))
  (body))
(lemma conn_init (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)))
  (requires (== (len es) 0) (forall ((y int)) (=> (in_s ins y) (== y 0))))

(lemma all_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (no_cross g ins) (in_s ins 0) (== (len ins) (len g)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))

    (if (in_s ins x)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (out_after ins p (- (len p) 2)))
        (call last_cross ins p (- (len p) 1))
        (obtain ((m int)) (cross_at ins p m))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g (idx p m))))))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p m)) i0) 0) (idx p (+ m 1)))))
        (assert (crosses g ins (idx p m) i0))
        (assert false)))))
(lemma all_in_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (no_cross g ins) (in_s ins 0) (== (len ins) (len g)))

(lemma span_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (conn_s es ins 0) (all_in_s ins) (== (len ins) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (assert (in_s ins u))
    (assert (in_s ins v))
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 u))
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 v))
    (call conn_sym es 0 u)
    (call conn_trans es u 0 v)))
(lemma min_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g es) (== (len es) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g o))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight es) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (assert (extendable g es))
    (assert (ext_at g es o))
    (obtain ((t2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g es t2 o))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t2))
    (assert (== (len t2) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (prefix_of es t2))
    (assert (== t2 es))))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (== (size graph) n))
    (assert (nbr_ok g))
    (let-mut ins (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j0) 0)))
    (set-idx ins 0 1)
    (let-mut edges (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (assert (forall ((x0 int)) (=> (in_s ins x0) (== x0 0))))
    (call conn_init edges ins)
    (call ext_init g edges)
    (let-mut done bool false)
    (while (not done)
      (invariant (== (len ins) n))
      (invariant (in_s ins 0))
      (invariant (== (+ (len edges) (occurrences ins 0)) (- n 1)))
      (invariant (>= (occurrences ins 0) 0))
      (invariant (are_valid_edges g edges))
      (invariant (conn_s edges ins 0))
      (invariant (inside edges ins))
      (invariant (extendable g edges))
      (invariant (=> done (all_in_s ins)))
      (decreases (+ (occurrences ins 0) (if done 0 1)))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut bu i64 0)
      (let-mut bi i64 0)
      (let-mut bw i64 0)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (seen_min g ins u 0 found bw))
        (invariant (=> found (best_ok g ins bu bi bw)))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
        (assert (== deg (len (idx g u))))
        (let-mut i i64 0)
        (while (< i deg)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
          (invariant (seen_min g ins u i found bw))
          (invariant (=> found (best_ok g ins bu bi bw)))
          (decreases (- deg i))
          (let v i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
          (let w i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))
          (assert (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
          (assert (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
          (let cr bool (!= (!= (idx ins u) 0) (!= (idx ins v) 0)))
          (assert (== cr (crosses g ins u i)))
          (ghost-let found0 bool found)
          (ghost-let bw0 int bw)
          (if (and cr (or (not found) (< w bw)))
            (block (set found true) (set bu u) (set bi i) (set bw w))
            (block))
          (call scan_step g ins u i found0 bw0 found bw)
          (set i (+ i 1)))
        (call row_done g ins u found bw)
        (set u (+ u 1)))
      (if found
        (block
          (call scan_cut g ins found bw)
          (assert (best_ok g ins bu bi bw))
          (let nv i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) bu) bi) 0))
          (assert (== nv (get (idx (idx g bu) bi) 0)))
          (assert (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv n)))
          (let bu_in bool (!= (idx ins bu) 0))
          (let newv i64 (if bu_in nv bu))
          (ghost-let olda int (if bu_in bu nv))

  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (- (len q) 1))) (in_s ins (idx q m)))
             (and (not (in_s ins (idx q (+ m 1)))) (out_after ins q m)))))
(ghost-fn rev ((p (seq int))) (seq int)
  (body (seq-build (len p) (fn (i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i))))))
(ghost-fn cat ((p (seq int)) (r (seq int))) (seq int) (requires (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len r) 0)))
  (body (seq-build (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1) (fn (i) (if (< i (len p)) (idx p i) (idx r (+ (- i (len p)) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn upd_in ((i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len i1) (len i0)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len i0))))
             (and (!= (idx i1 b) 0)
                  (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len i0))) (!= y b)) (== (idx i1 y) (idx i0 y))))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma occ_zero_take (params (s (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (all_in_s s) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences (take s k) 0) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call occ_zero_take s (- k 1))
        (assert (!= (idx s (- k 1)) 0))
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) 0)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) 0))
      (call law_occurrences_none s 0))))
(lemma occ_zero (params (s (seq int)))
  (requires (all_in_s s))
  (ensures (== (occurrences s 0) 0))
  (body (call occ_zero_take s (len s)) (call law_take_all s)))

(lemma scan_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (found bool) (bw int) (found2 bool) (bw2 int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (seen_min g ins u i found bw)
    (=> (crosses g ins u i) (and found2 (<= bw2 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
    (=> found (and found2 (<= bw2 bw))))
  (ensures (seen_min g ins u (+ i 1) found2 bw2))
  (body))
(lemma row_done (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (u int) (found bool) (bw int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (seen_min g ins u (len (idx g u)) found bw))
  (ensures (seen_min g ins (+ u 1) 0 found bw))
  (body))
(lemma scan_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (found bool) (bw int))
  (requires (seen_min g ins (len g) 0 found bw))
  (ensures (cut_min g ins bw))
  (body))
(lemma scan_none (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (bw int))
  (requires (seen_min g ins (len g) 0 false bw))
  (ensures (no_cross g ins))
  (body))

(lemma edge_pick (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (exists ((ee int)) (pair_at es ee x y)))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set es x y))
    (obtain ((ee int)) (and (and (<= 0 ee) (< ee (len es)))
                            (or (and (== (get (idx es ee) 0) x) (== (get (idx es ee) 1) y))
                                (and (== (get (idx es ee) 0) y) (== (get (idx es ee) 1) x)))))
    (assert (pair_at es ee x y))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es y x))
  (body (call edge_pick es x y) (obtain ((ee int)) (pair_at es ee x y)) (assert (pair_at es ee y x))))
(lemma edge_conn (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x y))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) y))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))))
(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x x))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges es p)))))
(lemma rev_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (rev p) k) (idx (rev p) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let k2 int (- (- (len p) 2) k))
    (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k2) (idx p (+ k2 1))))
    (call edge_sym es (idx p k2) (idx p (+ k2 1)))
    (assert (== (len (rev p)) (len p)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) k) (idx p (+ k2 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (+ k 1)) (idx p k2)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step es p k))
    (assert (== (len (rev p)) (len p)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es (rev p)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (- (len (rev p)) 1)) x))))
(lemma cat_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (path_follows_edges es r) (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len r) 0))
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx r 0))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (cat p r)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (cat p r) k) (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (cat p r)) (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1)))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let k3 int (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx r k3) (idx r (+ k3 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) k) (idx r k3)))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1)) (idx r (+ k3 1))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) y) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es r)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_step es p r k))
    (assert (== (len (cat p r)) (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es (cat p r)))
    (assert (== (idx (cat p r) 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (- (len (cat p r)) 1)) z))))

(lemma edge_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t x y))
  (body
    (call edge_pick es x y)
    (obtain ((ee int)) (pair_at es ee x y))
    (assert (== (idx t ee) (idx es ee)))
    (assert (pair_at t ee x y))))
(lemma path_mono_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_mono es t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected t x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call path_mono_step es t p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t p))))

(lemma lift1 (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (edge_in_set t x y) (not (pair_at t j x y)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t3 x y))
  (body
    (call edge_pick t x y)
    (obtain ((ee int)) (pair_at t ee x y))
    (if (== ee k)
      (block (assert (!= j k)) (assert (== (idx t3 j) (idx t k))) (assert (pair_at t3 j x y)))
      (block (assert (== (idx t3 ee) (idx t ee))) (assert (pair_at t3 ee x y))))))
(lemma reroute (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (path_follows_edges t p) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
            (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 (idx p 0) (idx p i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (call conn_refl t3 (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call reroute t t3 j k p (- i 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (if (pair_at t j (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))
          (if (== (get (idx t j) 0) (idx p (- i 1)))
            (assert (edges_connected t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
            (call conn_sym t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
          (block
            (call lift1 t t3 j k (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))
            (call edge_conn t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))))
        (assert (edges_connected t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (call conn_trans t3 (idx p 0) (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))))))
(lemma suffix (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (ins (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (path_follows_edges t q) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m i)) (< i (len q)))
            (out_after ins q m)
            (or (in_s ins (get (idx t j) 0)) (in_s ins (get (idx t j) 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx q i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i (+ m 1))
      (call conn_refl t3 (idx q i))
      (block
        (call suffix t t3 j k ins q m (- i 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i)))
        (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q (- i 1)))))
        (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q i))))
        (assert (not (pair_at t j (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))))
        (call lift1 t t3 j k (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))
        (call edge_conn t3 (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))
        (call conn_trans t3 (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))))))
(lemma last_cross (params (ins (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (> (len q) 0) (in_s ins (idx q 0)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))) (out_after ins q (- i 1)))
  (ensures (exists ((m int)) (cross_at ins q m)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q i))))
    (assert (>= i 1))
    (if (in_s ins (idx q (- i 1)))
      (assert (cross_at ins q (- i 1)))
      (block
        (assert (out_after ins q (- i 2)))
        (call last_cross ins q (- i 1))))))

(lemma tw_upd (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd_t s i x)) (+ (- (total_weight s) (get (idx s i) 2)) (get x 2))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd_t s i x)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd_t s i x)) (+ (get (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd_t s i x) 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) x))
        (assert (== (drop (upd_t s i x) 1) (drop s 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) (idx s 0)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd_t s i x) 1) (upd_t (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)))
        (call tw_upd (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- i 1)) (idx s i)))))))
(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g s) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (upd_t s i x)))
  (body))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (rel t t3 j k) (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t u v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (call reroute t t3 j k p (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma prefix_rel (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (rel t t3 j k) (== k (len es)) (<= k j))
  (ensures (prefix_of es t3))
  (body))
(lemma prefix_push_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t3) (< (len es) (len t3)) (== (idx t3 (len es)) e)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ (len es) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx t3 i) (idx (concat es (seq-lit e)) i)))
  (body
    (if (< i (len es))
      (assert (== (idx t3 i) (idx es i)))
      (assert (== i (len es))))))
(lemma prefix_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (prefix_of es t3) (< (len es) (len t3)) (== (idx t3 (len es)) e))
  (ensures (prefix_of (concat es (seq-lit e)) t3))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat es (seq-lit e))) (+ (len es) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_push_at es e t3 i))))

(lemma exchange
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2))
    (is_spanning_tree g t)
    (prefix_of es t))
  (ensures (exists ((t4 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t4 t)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (edges_connected t a b))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t q)))
    (assert (out_after ins q (- (len q) 2)))
    (call last_cross ins q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((m int)) (cross_at ins q m))
    (ghost-let fm int (idx q m))
    (ghost-let fm1 int (idx q (+ m 1)))
    (assert (in_s ins fm))
    (assert (not (in_s ins fm1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set t fm fm1))
    (call edge_pick t fm fm1)
    (obtain ((j int)) (pair_at t j fm fm1))
    (ghost-let k int (len es))
    (if (< j k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t j) (idx es j)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx es j) 0)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx es j) 1)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (and (<= k j) (< j (len t))))
    (ghost-let tk (tuple int int int) (idx t k))
    (assert (has_edge g (get tk 0) (get tk 1) (get tk 2)))
    (ghost-let t1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd_t t j tk))
    (ghost-let t3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd_t t1 k e))
    (assert (== (len t1) (len t)))
    (assert (== (len t3) (len t)))
    (call tw_upd t j tk)
    (call tw_upd t1 k e)
    (call valid_upd g t j tk)
    (call valid_upd g t1 k e)
    (assert (== (idx t1 k) tk))
    (assert (== (idx t3 k) e))
    (assert (rel t t3 j k))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1) (get (idx t j) 2)))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx t j) 0)) (< (get (idx t j) 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g (get (idx t j) 0))))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t j) 0)) i0) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t j) 0)) i0) 1) (get (idx t j) 2)))))
    (assert (crosses g ins (get (idx t j) 0) i0))
    (assert (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get (idx t j) 2)))
    (assert (<= (total_weight t3) (total_weight t)))
    (assert (== (len t3) (- (len g) 1)))
    (call prefix_rel es t t3 j k)
    (call prefix_push es e t3)
    (assert (prefix_of es t3))
    (assert (edges_connected es start fm))
    (assert (edges_connected es start a))
    (call conn_mono es t3 start fm)
    (call conn_mono es t3 start a)
    (assert (pair_at t3 k a b))
    (assert (edge_in_set t3 a b))
    (call edge_conn t3 a b)
    (call suffix t t3 j k ins q m (- (len q) 1))
    (call conn_sym t3 start fm)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm start a)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm a b)
    (call conn_sym t3 fm1 b)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm b fm1)
    (if (== (get (idx t j) 0) fm)
      (assert (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
      (call conn_sym t3 fm fm1))
    (assert (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_one g t t3 j k u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g t3))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t3))
    (assert (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t3 t))))
(lemma extend_one
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g es)
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
  (ensures (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g t)
      (block
        (assert (extendable g es))
        (assert (ext_at g es t))
        (obtain ((t2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g es t2 t))
        (assert (is_spanning_tree g t2))
        (assert (prefix_of es t2))
        (call exchange g ins start es e a b t2)
        (obtain ((t5 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t5 t2))
        (assert (<= (total_weight t2) (total_weight t)))
        (assert (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t5 t))
        (assert (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t)))
      (assert (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t)))))
(lemma extend_inv
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (extendable g es)
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)

    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step es p k))
    (assert (== (len (rev p)) (len p)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es (rev p)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (- (len (rev p)) 1)) x))))
(lemma cat_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (path_follows_edges es r) (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len r) 0))
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx r 0))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (cat p r)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (cat p r) k) (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (cat p r)) (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1)))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let k3 int (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx r k3) (idx r (+ k3 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) k) (idx r k3)))
        (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (+ k 1)) (idx r (+ k3 1))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) y) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es r)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_step es p r k))
    (assert (== (len (cat p r)) (- (+ (len p) (len r)) 1)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es (cat p r)))
    (assert (== (idx (cat p r) 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx (cat p r) (- (len (cat p r)) 1)) z))))

(lemma edge_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t x y))
  (body
    (call edge_pick es x y)
    (obtain ((ee int)) (pair_at es ee x y))
    (assert (== (idx t ee) (idx es ee)))
    (assert (pair_at t ee x y))))
(lemma path_mono_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_mono es t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected t x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call path_mono_step es t p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t p))))

(lemma lift1 (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (edge_in_set t x y) (not (pair_at t j x y)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t3 x y))
  (body
    (call edge_pick t x y)
    (obtain ((ee int)) (pair_at t ee x y))
    (if (== ee k)
      (block (assert (!= j k)) (assert (== (idx t3 j) (idx t k))) (assert (pair_at t3 j x y)))
      (block (assert (== (idx t3 ee) (idx t ee))) (assert (pair_at t3 ee x y))))))
(lemma reroute (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (path_follows_edges t p) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
            (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 (idx p 0) (idx p i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (call conn_refl t3 (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call reroute t t3 j k p (- i 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (if (pair_at t j (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))
          (if (== (get (idx t j) 0) (idx p (- i 1)))
            (assert (edges_connected t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
            (call conn_sym t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
          (block
            (call lift1 t t3 j k (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))
            (call edge_conn t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))))
        (assert (edges_connected t3 (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (call conn_trans t3 (idx p 0) (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i))))))
(lemma suffix (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (ins (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (rel t t3 j k) (path_follows_edges t q) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m i)) (< i (len q)))
            (out_after ins q m)
            (or (in_s ins (get (idx t j) 0)) (in_s ins (get (idx t j) 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx q i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i (+ m 1))
      (call conn_refl t3 (idx q i))
      (block
        (call suffix t t3 j k ins q m (- i 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i)))
        (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q (- i 1)))))
        (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q i))))
        (assert (not (pair_at t j (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))))
        (call lift1 t t3 j k (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))
        (call edge_conn t3 (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))
        (call conn_trans t3 (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx q (- i 1)) (idx q i))))))
(lemma last_cross (params (ins (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (> (len q) 0) (in_s ins (idx q 0)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))) (out_after ins q (- i 1)))
  (ensures (exists ((m int)) (cross_at ins q m)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (not (in_s ins (idx q i))))
    (assert (>= i 1))
    (if (in_s ins (idx q (- i 1)))
      (assert (cross_at ins q (- i 1)))
      (block
        (assert (out_after ins q (- i 2)))
        (call last_cross ins q (- i 1))))))

(lemma tw_upd (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd_t s i x)) (+ (- (total_weight s) (get (idx s i) 2)) (get x 2))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd_t s i x)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd_t s i x)) (+ (get (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd_t s i x) 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) x))
        (assert (== (drop (upd_t s i x) 1) (drop s 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd_t s i x) 0) (idx s 0)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd_t s i x) 1) (upd_t (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)))
        (call tw_upd (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- i 1)) (idx s i)))))))
(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g s) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (upd_t s i x)))
  (body))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (rel t t3 j k) (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t3 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t u v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (call reroute t t3 j k p (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma prefix_rel (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t) (rel t t3 j k) (== k (len es)) (<= k j))
  (ensures (prefix_of es t3))
  (body))
(lemma prefix_push_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (prefix_of es t3) (< (len es) (len t3)) (== (idx t3 (len es)) e)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ (len es) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx t3 i) (idx (concat es (seq-lit e)) i)))
  (body
    (if (< i (len es))
      (assert (== (idx t3 i) (idx es i)))
      (assert (== i (len es))))))
(lemma prefix_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t3 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (prefix_of es t3) (< (len es) (len t3)) (== (idx t3 (len es)) e))
  (ensures (prefix_of (concat es (seq-lit e)) t3))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat es (seq-lit e))) (+ (len es) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_push_at es e t3 i))))

(lemma exchange
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2))
    (is_spanning_tree g t)
    (prefix_of es t))
  (ensures (exists ((t4 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t4 t)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (edges_connected t a b))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t q)))
    (assert (out_after ins q (- (len q) 2)))
    (call last_cross ins q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((m int)) (cross_at ins q m))
    (ghost-let fm int (idx q m))
    (ghost-let fm1 int (idx q (+ m 1)))
    (assert (in_s ins fm))
    (assert (not (in_s ins fm1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set t fm fm1))
    (call edge_pick t fm fm1)
    (obtain ((j int)) (pair_at t j fm fm1))
    (ghost-let k int (len es))
    (if (< j k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t j) (idx es j)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx es j) 0)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx es j) 1)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (and (<= k j) (< j (len t))))
    (ghost-let tk (tuple int int int) (idx t k))
    (assert (has_edge g (get tk 0) (get tk 1) (get tk 2)))
    (ghost-let t1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd_t t j tk))
    (ghost-let t3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd_t t1 k e))
    (assert (== (len t1) (len t)))
    (assert (== (len t3) (len t)))
    (call tw_upd t j tk)
    (call tw_upd t1 k e)
    (call valid_upd g t j tk)
    (call valid_upd g t1 k e)
    (assert (== (idx t1 k) tk))
    (assert (== (idx t3 k) e))
    (assert (rel t t3 j k))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1) (get (idx t j) 2)))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx t j) 0)) (< (get (idx t j) 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g (get (idx t j) 0))))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t j) 0)) i0) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx t j) 0)) i0) 1) (get (idx t j) 2)))))
    (assert (crosses g ins (get (idx t j) 0) i0))
    (assert (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get (idx t j) 2)))
    (assert (<= (total_weight t3) (total_weight t)))
    (assert (== (len t3) (- (len g) 1)))
    (call prefix_rel es t t3 j k)
    (call prefix_push es e t3)
    (assert (prefix_of es t3))
    (assert (edges_connected es start fm))
    (assert (edges_connected es start a))
    (call conn_mono es t3 start fm)
    (call conn_mono es t3 start a)
    (assert (pair_at t3 k a b))
    (assert (edge_in_set t3 a b))
    (call edge_conn t3 a b)
    (call suffix t t3 j k ins q m (- (len q) 1))
    (call conn_sym t3 start fm)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm start a)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm a b)
    (call conn_sym t3 fm1 b)
    (call conn_trans t3 fm b fm1)
    (if (== (get (idx t j) 0) fm)
      (assert (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
      (call conn_sym t3 fm fm1))
    (assert (edges_connected t3 (get (idx t j) 0) (get (idx t j) 1)))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_one g t t3 j k u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g t3))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t3))
    (assert (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t3 t))))
(lemma extend_one
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g es)
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
  (ensures (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g t)
      (block
        (assert (extendable g es))
        (assert (ext_at g es t))
        (obtain ((t2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g es t2 t))
        (assert (is_spanning_tree g t2))
        (assert (prefix_of es t2))
        (call exchange g ins start es e a b t2)
        (obtain ((t5 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t5 t2))
        (assert (<= (total_weight t2) (total_weight t)))
        (assert (better g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t5 t))
        (assert (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t)))
      (assert (ext_at g (concat es (seq-lit e)) t)))))
(lemma extend_inv
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (start int) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (extendable g es)
    (== (len ins) (len g))
    (conn_s es ins start)
    (inside es ins)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
    (in_s ins a)
    (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (not (in_s ins b)))
    (cut_min g ins (get e 2)))
  (ensures (extendable g (concat es (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((t (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call extend_one g ins start es e a b t))))
(lemma ext_init_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len es) 0))
  (ensures (ext_at g es t))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g t)
      (block (assert (prefix_of es t)) (assert (better g es t t)) (assert (ext_at g es t)))
      (assert (ext_at g es t)))))
(lemma ext_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len es) 0))
  (ensures (extendable g es))
  (body (forall ((t (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_init_one g es t))))

(lemma in_mono (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (upd_in i0 i1 b) (in_s i0 x))
  (ensures (in_s i1 x))
  (body))
(lemma inside_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (inside es i0) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0)))))
  (ensures (inside (concat es (seq-lit e)) i1))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call in_mono i0 i1 b x))
    (assert (in_s i1 a))
    (assert (in_s i1 b))))
(lemma conn_push_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (start int) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (conn_s es i0 start) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0))))
            (in_s i1 x))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit e)) start x))
  (body
    (ghost-let es1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es (seq-lit e)))
    (assert (prefix_of es es1))
    (if (in_s i0 x)
      (block (assert (edges_connected es start x)) (call conn_mono es es1 start x))
      (block
        (assert (== x b))
        (assert (edges_connected es start a))
        (call conn_mono es es1 start a)
        (assert (pair_at es1 (len es) a b))
        (assert (edge_in_set es1 a b))
        (call edge_conn es1 a b)
        (call conn_trans es1 start a b)))))
(lemma conn_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (start int) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (conn_s es i0 start) (in_s i0 a) (upd_in i0 i1 b)
            (or (and (== a (get e 0)) (== b (get e 1))) (and (== a (get e 1)) (== b (get e 0)))))
  (ensures (conn_s (concat es (seq-lit e)) i1 start))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call conn_push_one es i0 i1 start e a b x))))
(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat es (seq-lit e))))
  (body))
(lemma conn_init (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)))
  (requires (== (len es) 0) (forall ((y int)) (=> (in_s ins y) (== y 0))))
  (ensures (conn_s es ins 0))
  (body (call conn_refl es 0)))

(lemma all_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (no_cross g ins) (in_s ins 0) (== (len ins) (len g)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
  (ensures (in_s ins x))
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (if (in_s ins x)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (out_after ins p (- (len p) 2)))
        (call last_cross ins p (- (len p) 1))
        (obtain ((m int)) (cross_at ins p m))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g (idx p m))))))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p m)) i0) 0) (idx p (+ m 1)))))
        (assert (crosses g ins (idx p m) i0))
        (assert false)))))
(lemma all_in_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (no_cross g ins) (in_s ins 0) (== (len ins) (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len ins))) (!= (idx ins x) 0)))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len ins)))
      (block (call all_in g ins x) (assert (in_s ins x)) (assert (!= (idx ins x) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma all_in_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (no_cross g ins) (in_s ins 0) (== (len ins) (len g)))
  (ensures (all_in_s ins))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call all_in_at g ins x))
    (assert (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len ins))) (!= (idx ins x) 0))))
    (assert (all_in_s ins))))
(lemma span_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (conn_s es ins 0) (all_in_s ins) (== (len ins) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (assert (in_s ins u))
    (assert (in_s ins v))
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 u))
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 v))

(lemma net_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins lab s) (not (ins lab t)) (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))

      (if (and (ins lab (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s))

          (call split_col g h lab (- k 1) (len g))
          (assert (== (term g h lab 0 (- k 1) (len g)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)))))
          (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))))))
          (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- k 1) (len g)))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma net_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins lab s) (not (ins lab t)) (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 0 (len g) k) (if (< s k) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases k)

    (block
      (call net_eq g h lab s t (- k 1))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 0 (- k 1) (len g)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
      (if (and (ins lab (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s))
        (block
          (assert (!= (- k 1) t))
          (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma d0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))

(lemma dstep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (kk int) (k int))
  (requires (>= kk 0) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 (+ kk 1) k) (+ (osum g h lab 3 kk k) (if (ins lab kk) (rows h lab kk k) 0))))
  (decreases k)

    (block
      (call dstep g h lab kk (- k 1))
      (assert (== (cols h lab (- k 1) (+ kk 1) true)
                  (+ (cols h lab (- k 1) kk true) (if (== (ins lab kk) true) (get_flow h kk (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (rows h lab kk k) (+ (rows h lab kk (- k 1)) (if (ins lab (- k 1)) (get_flow h kk (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 3 (- k 1) (+ kk 1)) (cols h lab (- k 1) (+ kk 1) true)))

(lemma tin_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (i int) (j int))

(lemma rowt_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (j int) (m int))

  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u (+ j 1) m)
