(lemma part_rowt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx g u)))))

  (body (call part_rowt g h lab u (len (idx g u))) (call rowt_full g h lab u (len g))))

(lemma flow_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (<= (len g) 1000))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g f s) 100000000))
  (body
    (call supp_flow g cap f)
    (ghost-let z (seq int) (seq-build (len g) (fn (q) 0)))

    (call part_side0 g f z s (len (idx g s)))

    (assert (== (total_flow_out g f s) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f s (len (idx g s)))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g))))))

(lemma opt_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (o (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
            (>= (idx lab s) 0) (< (idx lab t) 0) (is_conserved g f s t) (is_valid_flow g o s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g o s)))
  (body
    (call supp_flow g cap f)
    (call supp_valid g o s t)
    (call cut_id g f lab s t)
    (call cut_id g o lab s t)
    (forall ((u1 int)) (call le_oc g cap o lab s t u1))
    (call osum_le g o cap lab 2 (len g) (len g))
    (forall ((u2 int)) (call le_cf g cap f lab u2))
    (call osum_le g cap f lab 2 (len g) (len g))
    (forall ((u3 int)) (call le_fo g cap f o lab s t u3))
    (call osum_le g f o lab 4 (len g) (len g))))
(lemma max_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g))

            (>= (idx lab s) 0) (< (idx lab t) 0) (is_conserved g f s t))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call valid_f g cap f s t)
    (forall ((o (seq (seq int)))) (call opt_one g cap f lab s t o))))

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (ghost-let gg (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (assert (== gg (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== n (len gg)))
    (call wf_intro graph)
    (assert (wfg gg))
    (assert (capacities_bounded gg))
    (assert (<= n 1000))
    (let-mut cap (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (q1) (seq-build n (fn (q2) 0)))))
    (assert (mat cap n))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (capinv gg cap u 0))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (capinv gg cap u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
        (assert (and (== (get e 0) (get (idx (idx gg u) i) 0)) (== (get e 1) (get (idx (idx gg u) i) 1))))
        (assert (has_capacity gg u (get e 0) (get e 1)))
        (ghost-let c0 (seq (seq int)) cap)
        (set-idx (idx cap u) (get e 0) (get e 1))
        (assert (upd2 c0 cap u (get e 0) (get e 1)))
        (set i (+ i 1)))

            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h1 u k) (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h0 u k) (if (and (== u a) (< i0 k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call out_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 u (- k 1))
      (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (== (get_flow h1 u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))
                    (+ (get_flow h0 u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (if (and (== u a) (== i0 (- k 1))) d 0))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma ex_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (w int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len h0) (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len h0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h0 a))))
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_in g h1 w) (total_flow_out g h1 w))
               (- (+ (- (total_flow_in g h0 w) (total_flow_out g h0 w)) (if (== w b) d 0)) (if (== w a) d 0))))
  (body
    (call in_upd g h0 h1 a b d w (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h1 w) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h1 w (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h0 w) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h0 w (len g))))
    (if (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 w (len (idx g w)))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h1 w) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h1 w (len (idx g w)))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h0 w) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h0 w (len (idx g w))))))
      (block))))
(lemma aug_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (mat h0 (len g))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (> (idx (idx cap a) b) 0)
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d)))
  (ensures (forall ((w int)) (== (- (total_flow_in g h1 w) (total_flow_out g h1 w))
             (- (+ (- (total_flow_in g h0 w) (total_flow_out g h0 w)) (if (== w b) d 0)) (if (== w a) d 0)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_capacity g a b (idx (idx cap a) b)))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call ex_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 w))))

(lemma split_part (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (+ (part g h lab u k true) (part g h lab u k false))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call split_part g h lab u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma split_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (+ (cols h lab u k true) (cols h lab u k false))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call split_col g h lab u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma decomp (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 0 (len g) k)
               (- (- (+ (osum g h lab 1 (len g) k) (osum g h lab 2 (len g) k)) (osum g h lab 3 (len g) k)) (osum g h lab 4 (len g) k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call decomp g h lab (- k 1))
      (if (< (- k 1) (len g))
        (block
          (call split_part g h lab (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))))
          (call split_col g h lab (- k 1) (len g))
          (assert (== (term g h lab 0 (- k 1) (len g)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)))))
          (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))))))
          (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- k 1) (len g)))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma net_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins lab s) (not (ins lab t)) (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 0 (len g) k) (if (< s k) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call net_eq g h lab s t (- k 1))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 0 (- k 1) (len g)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
      (if (and (ins lab (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s))
        (block
          (assert (!= (- k 1) t))
          (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma d0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call d0 g h lab (- k 1)) (assert (== (cols h lab (- k 1) 0 true) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dstep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (kk int) (k int))
  (requires (>= kk 0) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 (+ kk 1) k) (+ (osum g h lab 3 kk k) (if (ins lab kk) (rows h lab kk k) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call dstep g h lab kk (- k 1))
      (assert (== (cols h lab (- k 1) (+ kk 1) true)
                  (+ (cols h lab (- k 1) kk true) (if (== (ins lab kk) true) (get_flow h kk (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (rows h lab kk k) (+ (rows h lab kk (- k 1)) (if (ins lab (- k 1)) (get_flow h kk (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 3 (- k 1) (+ kk 1)) (cols h lab (- k 1) (+ kk 1) true)))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 3 (- k 1) kk) (cols h lab (- k 1) kk true))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (kk int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 kk) (<= kk (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 kk k) (osum g h lab 5 k kk)))
  (decreases kk)
  (body (if (> kk 0)
    (block
      (call swap g h lab (- kk 1) k)
      (call dstep g h lab (- kk 1) k)
      (assert (== (term g h lab 5 (- kk 1) k) (rows h lab (- kk 1) k))))
    (call d0 g h lab k))))

(lemma tin_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (<= j (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (tin g u v j))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (< i (- j 1)) (call tin_intro g u v i (- j 1)) (block))))
(lemma tin_dist (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j i)) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (tin g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) j)))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0) (call tin_dist g u i (- j 1)) (block))))
(lemma rowt0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call rowt0 g h lab u (- m 1)) (assert (not (tin g u (- m 1) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (j int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u (+ j 1) m)
               (+ (rowt g h lab u j m)
                  (if (and (< (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) m) (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
                      (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_step g h lab u j (- m 1))
      (call tin_dist g u j j)
      (assert (== (tin g u (- m 1) (+ j 1)) (or (tin g u (- m 1) j) (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma part_rowt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (part g h lab u j true) (rowt g h lab u j (len g))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0)
    (block (call part_rowt g h lab u (- j 1)) (call rowt_step g h lab u (- j 1) (len g)))
    (call rowt0 g h lab u (len g)))))
(lemma rowt_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u (len (idx g u)) m) (rows h lab u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_full g h lab u (- m 1))
      (if (!= (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- m 1))))
          (call tin_intro g u (- m 1) i (len (idx g u))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma reindex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (part g h lab u (len (idx g u)) true) (rows h lab u (len g))))
  (body (call part_rowt g h lab u (len (idx g u))) (call rowt_full g h lab u (len g))))
(lemma suma (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 1 (len g) k) (osum g h lab 5 (len g) k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call suma g h lab (- k 1))
      (call reindex g h lab (- k 1))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 1 (- k 1) (len g)) (part g h lab (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))) true)))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 5 (- k 1) (len g)) (rows h lab (- k 1) (len g)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cut_id (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins lab s) (not (ins lab t)) (is_conserved g h s t) (supp g h))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (- (osum g h lab 2 (len g) (len g)) (osum g h lab 4 (len g) (len g)))))
  (body
    (call net_eq g h lab s t (len g))
    (call decomp g h lab (len g))
    (call swap g h lab (len g) (len g))
    (call suma g h lab (len g))))

(lemma part_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (side bool))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))) (< i (len (idx g u))))
          (=> (== (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) side)
              (<= (get_flow h1 u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow h2 u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
  (ensures (<= (part g h1 lab u k side) (part g h2 lab u k side)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call part_le g h1 h2 lab u (- k 1) side) (block))))
(lemma cols_le (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (side bool))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (== (ins lab j) side)) (<= (get_flow h1 j u) (get_flow h2 j u)))))
  (ensures (<= (cols h1 lab u k side) (cols h2 lab u k side)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cols_le h1 h2 lab u (- k 1) side) (block))))
(lemma osum_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (w int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u k)) (ins lab u)) (<= (term g h1 lab w u m) (term g h2 lab w u m)))))
  (ensures (<= (osum g h1 lab w m k) (osum g h2 lab w m k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call osum_le g h1 h2 lab w m (- k 1)) (block))))

(lemma edge_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (body
    (ghost-let v int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (respects_capacity g h))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) c))))
        (assert (== j i)))
      (block))))
(lemma le_oc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (term g h lab 2 u (len g)) (term g cap lab 2 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call edge_le g cap h s t u i))
    (call part_le g h cap lab u (len (idx g u)) false)))
(lemma ent_cf (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) false))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (body (assert (< (idx lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 0))))
(lemma le_cf (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u))
  (ensures (<= (term g cap lab 2 u (len g)) (term g f lab 2 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call ent_cf g cap f lab u i))
    (call part_le g cap f lab u (len (idx g u)) false)))
(lemma ent_fo (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len g))) (== (ins lab j) false))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow f j u) (get_flow h j u)))
  (body
    (assert (< (idx lab j) 0))
    (assert (<= (idx (idx f j) u) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow h j u) 0))))
(lemma le_fo (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u))
  (ensures (<= (term g f lab 4 u (len g)) (term g h lab 4 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call ent_fo g cap f h lab s t u j))
    (call cols_le f h lab u (len g) false)))

(lemma supp_v1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow h u v) 0)
               (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (respects_capacity g h))
        (assert (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c)))
      (block))))
(lemma supp_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (supp g h))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call supp_v1 g h s t u v))))
(lemma supp_f1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0)
               (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow f u v) 0) (assert (has_capacity g u v (idx (idx cap u) v))) (block))))
(lemma supp_flow (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (supp g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call supp_f1 g cap f u v))))
(lemma resp1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
               (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0) (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (block
        (assert (mat f (len g)))
        (assert (and (< u (len g)) (< v (len g))))
        (if (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (idx (idx cap u) v)))
            (assert (has_capacity g u v (idx (idx cap u) v))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma resp_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp1 g cap f u v))
    (assert (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
          (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0) (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))))
(lemma valid_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (is_conserved g f s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body (call resp_all g cap f)))

(lemma part_side0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (ins lab v))) (>= k 0))

    (if (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g))) (call zout g h w (len (idx g w))) (block))
    (call zin g h w (len g))))

(lemma in_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len h0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h0 a))))
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d)) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h1 w k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h0 w k) (if (and (== w b) (< a k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call in_upd g h0 h1 a b d w (- k 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow h1 (- k 1) w) (+ (get_flow h0 (- k 1) w) (if (and (== w b) (== a (- k 1))) d 0)))))
    (block))))
(lemma out_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len h0) (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len h0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h0 a))))
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h1 u k) (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h0 u k) (if (and (== u a) (< i0 k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call out_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 u (- k 1))
      (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (== (get_flow h1 u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))
                    (+ (get_flow h0 u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (if (and (== u a) (== i0 (- k 1))) d 0))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma ex_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (w int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len h0) (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len h0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h0 a))))
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_in g h1 w) (total_flow_out g h1 w))
               (- (+ (- (total_flow_in g h0 w) (total_flow_out g h0 w)) (if (== w b) d 0)) (if (== w a) d 0))))
  (body
    (call in_upd g h0 h1 a b d w (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h1 w) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h1 w (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h0 w) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h0 w (len g))))
    (if (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 w (len (idx g w)))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h1 w) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h1 w (len (idx g w)))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h0 w) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h0 w (len (idx g w))))))
      (block))))
(lemma aug_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (mat h0 (len g))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (> (idx (idx cap a) b) 0)
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d)))
  (ensures (forall ((w int)) (== (- (total_flow_in g h1 w) (total_flow_out g h1 w))
             (- (+ (- (total_flow_in g h0 w) (total_flow_out g h0 w)) (if (== w b) d 0)) (if (== w a) d 0)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_capacity g a b (idx (idx cap a) b)))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call ex_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 w))))

(lemma split_part (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (+ (part g h lab u k true) (part g h lab u k false))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call split_part g h lab u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma split_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (+ (cols h lab u k true) (cols h lab u k false))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call split_col g h lab u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma decomp (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 0 (len g) k)
               (- (- (+ (osum g h lab 1 (len g) k) (osum g h lab 2 (len g) k)) (osum g h lab 3 (len g) k)) (osum g h lab 4 (len g) k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call decomp g h lab (- k 1))
      (if (< (- k 1) (len g))
        (block
          (call split_part g h lab (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))))
          (call split_col g h lab (- k 1) (len g))
          (assert (== (term g h lab 0 (- k 1) (len g)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)))))
          (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))))))
          (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- k 1) (len g)))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma net_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins lab s) (not (ins lab t)) (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 0 (len g) k) (if (< s k) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call net_eq g h lab s t (- k 1))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 0 (- k 1) (len g)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
      (if (and (ins lab (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s))
        (block
          (assert (!= (- k 1) t))
          (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma d0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call d0 g h lab (- k 1)) (assert (== (cols h lab (- k 1) 0 true) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dstep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (kk int) (k int))
  (requires (>= kk 0) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 (+ kk 1) k) (+ (osum g h lab 3 kk k) (if (ins lab kk) (rows h lab kk k) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call dstep g h lab kk (- k 1))
      (assert (== (cols h lab (- k 1) (+ kk 1) true)
                  (+ (cols h lab (- k 1) kk true) (if (== (ins lab kk) true) (get_flow h kk (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (rows h lab kk k) (+ (rows h lab kk (- k 1)) (if (ins lab (- k 1)) (get_flow h kk (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 3 (- k 1) (+ kk 1)) (cols h lab (- k 1) (+ kk 1) true)))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 3 (- k 1) kk) (cols h lab (- k 1) kk true))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (kk int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 kk) (<= kk (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 kk k) (osum g h lab 5 k kk)))
  (decreases kk)
  (body (if (> kk 0)
    (block
      (call swap g h lab (- kk 1) k)
      (call dstep g h lab (- kk 1) k)
      (assert (== (term g h lab 5 (- kk 1) k) (rows h lab (- kk 1) k))))
    (call d0 g h lab k))))

(lemma tin_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (<= j (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (tin g u v j))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (< i (- j 1)) (call tin_intro g u v i (- j 1)) (block))))
(lemma tin_dist (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j i)) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (tin g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) j)))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0) (call tin_dist g u i (- j 1)) (block))))
(lemma rowt0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call rowt0 g h lab u (- m 1)) (assert (not (tin g u (- m 1) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (j int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u (+ j 1) m)
               (+ (rowt g h lab u j m)
                  (if (and (< (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) m) (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
                      (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_step g h lab u j (- m 1))
      (call tin_dist g u j j)
      (assert (== (tin g u (- m 1) (+ j 1)) (or (tin g u (- m 1) j) (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma part_rowt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (part g h lab u j true) (rowt g h lab u j (len g))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0)
    (block (call part_rowt g h lab u (- j 1)) (call rowt_step g h lab u (- j 1) (len g)))
    (call rowt0 g h lab u (len g)))))
(lemma rowt_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u (len (idx g u)) m) (rows h lab u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_full g h lab u (- m 1))
      (if (!= (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- m 1))))
          (call tin_intro g u (- m 1) i (len (idx g u))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma reindex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (part g h lab u (len (idx g u)) true) (rows h lab u (len g))))
  (body (call part_rowt g h lab u (len (idx g u))) (call rowt_full g h lab u (len g))))
(lemma suma (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 1 (len g) k) (osum g h lab 5 (len g) k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call suma g h lab (- k 1))
      (call reindex g h lab (- k 1))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 1 (- k 1) (len g)) (part g h lab (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))) true)))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 5 (- k 1) (len g)) (rows h lab (- k 1) (len g)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cut_id (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins lab s) (not (ins lab t)) (is_conserved g h s t) (supp g h))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (- (osum g h lab 2 (len g) (len g)) (osum g h lab 4 (len g) (len g)))))
  (body
    (call net_eq g h lab s t (len g))
    (call decomp g h lab (len g))
    (call swap g h lab (len g) (len g))
    (call suma g h lab (len g))))

(lemma part_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (side bool))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))) (< i (len (idx g u))))
          (=> (== (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) side)
              (<= (get_flow h1 u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow h2 u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
  (ensures (<= (part g h1 lab u k side) (part g h2 lab u k side)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call part_le g h1 h2 lab u (- k 1) side) (block))))
(lemma cols_le (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (side bool))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (== (ins lab j) side)) (<= (get_flow h1 j u) (get_flow h2 j u)))))
  (ensures (<= (cols h1 lab u k side) (cols h2 lab u k side)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cols_le h1 h2 lab u (- k 1) side) (block))))
(lemma osum_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (w int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u k)) (ins lab u)) (<= (term g h1 lab w u m) (term g h2 lab w u m)))))
  (ensures (<= (osum g h1 lab w m k) (osum g h2 lab w m k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call osum_le g h1 h2 lab w m (- k 1)) (block))))

(lemma edge_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (body
    (ghost-let v int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (respects_capacity g h))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) c))))
        (assert (== j i)))
      (block))))
(lemma le_oc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (term g h lab 2 u (len g)) (term g cap lab 2 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call edge_le g cap h s t u i))
    (call part_le g h cap lab u (len (idx g u)) false)))
(lemma ent_cf (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) false))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (body (assert (< (idx lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 0))))
(lemma le_cf (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u))
  (ensures (<= (term g cap lab 2 u (len g)) (term g f lab 2 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call ent_cf g cap f lab u i))
    (call part_le g cap f lab u (len (idx g u)) false)))
(lemma ent_fo (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len g))) (== (ins lab j) false))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow f j u) (get_flow h j u)))
  (body
    (assert (< (idx lab j) 0))
    (assert (<= (idx (idx f j) u) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow h j u) 0))))
(lemma le_fo (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u))
  (ensures (<= (term g f lab 4 u (len g)) (term g h lab 4 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call ent_fo g cap f h lab s t u j))
    (call cols_le f h lab u (len g) false)))

(lemma supp_v1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow h u v) 0)
               (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (respects_capacity g h))
        (assert (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c)))
      (block))))
(lemma supp_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (supp g h))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call supp_v1 g h s t u v))))
(lemma supp_f1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0)
               (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow f u v) 0) (assert (has_capacity g u v (idx (idx cap u) v))) (block))))
(lemma supp_flow (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (supp g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call supp_f1 g cap f u v))))
(lemma resp1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
               (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0) (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (block
        (assert (mat f (len g)))
        (assert (and (< u (len g)) (< v (len g))))
        (if (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (idx (idx cap u) v)))
            (assert (has_capacity g u v (idx (idx cap u) v))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma resp_from (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))))

  (body (assert (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma wf_intro (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg) (capacities_bounded (view cg)))
  (ensures (wfg (view cg)))
  (body
    (assert (== (view cg) (field cg adj)))
    (forall ((u int) (i int)) (call cap_rng (view cg) u i))))

(lemma zout (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (mat h (len g))
            (forall ((a int) (b int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))) (== (idx (idx h a) b) 0)))
            (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call zout g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma zin (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (mat h (len g))
            (forall ((a int) (b int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))) (== (idx (idx h a) b) 0)))
            (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call zin g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma zero_tot (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w int))
  (requires (mat h (len g))
            (forall ((a int) (b int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))) (== (idx (idx h a) b) 0))))
  (ensures (and (== (total_flow_out g h w) 0) (== (total_flow_in g h w) 0)))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g))) (call zout g h w (len (idx g w))) (block))
    (call zin g h w (len g))))

(lemma in_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len h0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h0 a))))
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d)) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h1 w k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h0 w k) (if (and (== w b) (< a k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call in_upd g h0 h1 a b d w (- k 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow h1 (- k 1) w) (+ (get_flow h0 (- k 1) w) (if (and (== w b) (== a (- k 1))) d 0)))))
    (block))))
(lemma out_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len h0) (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len h0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h0 a))))
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h1 u k) (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h0 u k) (if (and (== u a) (< i0 k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call out_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 u (- k 1))
      (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (== (get_flow h1 u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))
                    (+ (get_flow h0 u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (if (and (== u a) (== i0 (- k 1))) d 0))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma ex_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (w int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len h0) (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len h0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h0 a))))
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_in g h1 w) (total_flow_out g h1 w))
               (- (+ (- (total_flow_in g h0 w) (total_flow_out g h0 w)) (if (== w b) d 0)) (if (== w a) d 0))))
  (body
    (call in_upd g h0 h1 a b d w (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h1 w) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h1 w (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h0 w) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h0 w (len g))))
    (if (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 w (len (idx g w)))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h1 w) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h1 w (len (idx g w)))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h0 w) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h0 w (len (idx g w))))))
      (block))))
(lemma aug_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (mat h0 (len g))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (> (idx (idx cap a) b) 0)
            (upd2 h0 h1 a b (+ (idx (idx h0 a) b) d)))
  (ensures (forall ((w int)) (== (- (total_flow_in g h1 w) (total_flow_out g h1 w))
             (- (+ (- (total_flow_in g h0 w) (total_flow_out g h0 w)) (if (== w b) d 0)) (if (== w a) d 0)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_capacity g a b (idx (idx cap a) b)))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call ex_upd g h0 h1 a b d i0 w))))

(lemma split_part (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (+ (part g h lab u k true) (part g h lab u k false))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call split_part g h lab u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma split_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (+ (cols h lab u k true) (cols h lab u k false))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call split_col g h lab u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma decomp (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 0 (len g) k)
               (- (- (+ (osum g h lab 1 (len g) k) (osum g h lab 2 (len g) k)) (osum g h lab 3 (len g) k)) (osum g h lab 4 (len g) k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call decomp g h lab (- k 1))
      (if (< (- k 1) (len g))
        (block
          (call split_part g h lab (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))))
          (call split_col g h lab (- k 1) (len g))
          (assert (== (term g h lab 0 (- k 1) (len g)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)))))
          (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))))))
          (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- k 1) (len g)))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma net_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins lab s) (not (ins lab t)) (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 0 (len g) k) (if (< s k) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call net_eq g h lab s t (- k 1))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 0 (- k 1) (len g)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
      (if (and (ins lab (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s))
        (block
          (assert (!= (- k 1) t))
          (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma d0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call d0 g h lab (- k 1)) (assert (== (cols h lab (- k 1) 0 true) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dstep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (kk int) (k int))
  (requires (>= kk 0) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 (+ kk 1) k) (+ (osum g h lab 3 kk k) (if (ins lab kk) (rows h lab kk k) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call dstep g h lab kk (- k 1))
      (assert (== (cols h lab (- k 1) (+ kk 1) true)
                  (+ (cols h lab (- k 1) kk true) (if (== (ins lab kk) true) (get_flow h kk (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (rows h lab kk k) (+ (rows h lab kk (- k 1)) (if (ins lab (- k 1)) (get_flow h kk (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 3 (- k 1) (+ kk 1)) (cols h lab (- k 1) (+ kk 1) true)))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 3 (- k 1) kk) (cols h lab (- k 1) kk true))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (kk int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 kk) (<= kk (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 3 kk k) (osum g h lab 5 k kk)))
  (decreases kk)
  (body (if (> kk 0)
    (block
      (call swap g h lab (- kk 1) k)
      (call dstep g h lab (- kk 1) k)
      (assert (== (term g h lab 5 (- kk 1) k) (rows h lab (- kk 1) k))))
    (call d0 g h lab k))))

(lemma tin_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (<= j (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (tin g u v j))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (< i (- j 1)) (call tin_intro g u v i (- j 1)) (block))))
(lemma tin_dist (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j i)) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (tin g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) j)))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0) (call tin_dist g u i (- j 1)) (block))))
(lemma rowt0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call rowt0 g h lab u (- m 1)) (assert (not (tin g u (- m 1) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (j int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u (+ j 1) m)
               (+ (rowt g h lab u j m)
                  (if (and (< (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) m) (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
                      (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_step g h lab u j (- m 1))
      (call tin_dist g u j j)
      (assert (== (tin g u (- m 1) (+ j 1)) (or (tin g u (- m 1) j) (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma part_rowt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (part g h lab u j true) (rowt g h lab u j (len g))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0)
    (block (call part_rowt g h lab u (- j 1)) (call rowt_step g h lab u (- j 1) (len g)))
    (call rowt0 g h lab u (len g)))))
(lemma rowt_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rowt g h lab u (len (idx g u)) m) (rows h lab u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_full g h lab u (- m 1))
      (if (!= (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- m 1))))
          (call tin_intro g u (- m 1) i (len (idx g u))))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma reindex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (part g h lab u (len (idx g u)) true) (rows h lab u (len g))))
  (body (call part_rowt g h lab u (len (idx g u))) (call rowt_full g h lab u (len g))))
(lemma suma (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (supp g h) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (osum g h lab 1 (len g) k) (osum g h lab 5 (len g) k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call suma g h lab (- k 1))
      (call reindex g h lab (- k 1))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 1 (- k 1) (len g)) (part g h lab (- k 1) (len (idx g (- k 1))) true)))
      (assert (== (term g h lab 5 (- k 1) (len g)) (rows h lab (- k 1) (len g)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cut_id (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins lab s) (not (ins lab t)) (is_conserved g h s t) (supp g h))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (- (osum g h lab 2 (len g) (len g)) (osum g h lab 4 (len g) (len g)))))
  (body
    (call net_eq g h lab s t (len g))
    (call decomp g h lab (len g))
    (call swap g h lab (len g) (len g))
    (call suma g h lab (len g))))

(lemma part_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (side bool))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))) (< i (len (idx g u))))
          (=> (== (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) side)
              (<= (get_flow h1 u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow h2 u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
  (ensures (<= (part g h1 lab u k side) (part g h2 lab u k side)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call part_le g h1 h2 lab u (- k 1) side) (block))))
(lemma cols_le (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (side bool))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (== (ins lab j) side)) (<= (get_flow h1 j u) (get_flow h2 j u)))))
  (ensures (<= (cols h1 lab u k side) (cols h2 lab u k side)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cols_le h1 h2 lab u (- k 1) side) (block))))
(lemma osum_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (w int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0)
    (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u k)) (ins lab u)) (<= (term g h1 lab w u m) (term g h2 lab w u m)))))
  (ensures (<= (osum g h1 lab w m k) (osum g h2 lab w m k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call osum_le g h1 h2 lab w m (- k 1)) (block))))

(lemma edge_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (body
    (ghost-let v int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (respects_capacity g h))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) c))))
        (assert (== j i)))
      (block))))
(lemma le_oc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (term g h lab 2 u (len g)) (term g cap lab 2 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call edge_le g cap h s t u i))
    (call part_le g h cap lab u (len (idx g u)) false)))
(lemma ent_cf (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (ins lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) false))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (body (assert (< (idx lab (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 0))))
(lemma le_cf (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u))
  (ensures (<= (term g cap lab 2 u (len g)) (term g f lab 2 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call ent_cf g cap f lab u i))
    (call part_le g cap f lab u (len (idx g u)) false)))
(lemma ent_fo (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len g))) (== (ins lab j) false))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow f j u) (get_flow h j u)))
  (body
    (assert (< (idx lab j) 0))
    (assert (<= (idx (idx f j) u) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow h j u) 0))))
(lemma le_fo (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (capinv g cap (len g) 0) (flowok cap f (len g)) (== (len lab) (len g))
            (closed cap f lab (len g) (len g)) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (ins lab u))
  (ensures (<= (term g f lab 4 u (len g)) (term g h lab 4 u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call ent_fo g cap f h lab s t u j))
    (call cols_le f h lab u (len g) false)))

(lemma supp_v1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow h u v) 0)
               (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (respects_capacity g h))
        (assert (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c)))
      (block))))
(lemma supp_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
